w|berdaya.ko: 비행이 취소되자 인탄은 어쩔 수 없는 무력감을 느꼈어요.

w|berdebat.text: Jangan berdebat jika emosi sedang tinggi.
w|berdebat.en: Don't debate when emotions are high.

w|berdering.text: Bel istirahat berdering, dan murid-murid berlarian ke kantin.
w|berdering.en: The break bell rang, and the students ran to the canteen.
w|berdering.ko: 쉬는 시간 종이 울리자 학생들이 매점으로 뛰어갔어요.

w|berdering.text: Telepon Siti terus berdering karena sopir truk bingung mencari alamat.
w|berdering.en: Siti's phone kept ringing because the truck driver couldn't find the address.
w|berdering.ko: 트럭 기사가 주소를 못 찾아 헤매서 시티 전화가 계속 울렸어요.

w|berdetak.text: Jantung Rudi berdetak kencang saat menemukan foto lama mereka berdua.
w|berdetak.en: Rudi's heart beat fast when he found an old photo of the two of them.
w|berdetak.ko: 둘이 찍은 옛날 사진을 찾았을 때 루디의 심장이 빠르게 뛰었어요.

w|berdetak.text: Jantung Rina berdetak cepat saat menekan tombol peluncuran.
w|berdetak.en: Rina's heart was beating fast as she pressed the launch button.
w|berdetak.ko: 출시 버튼을 누를 때 리나의 심장이 빠르게 뛰었어요.

w|berdiskusi.text: Di mobil, Agus dan teman-temannya berdiskusi soal tujuan berikutnya.
w|berdiskusi.en: In the car, Agus and his friends discussed where to go next.
w|berdiskusi.ko: 차 안에서 아구스와 친구들은 다음 목적지를 의논했어요.

w|berdiskusi.text: Para pegawai berdiskusi tentang cara menata etalase untuk musim liburan.
w|berdiskusi.en: The staff discussed how to arrange the display window for the holiday season.
w|berdiskusi.ko: 직원들은 휴가철에 맞춰 진열장을 꾸밀 방법을 의논했어요.

w|berdosa.text: Berbuat jahat dianggap berdosa di agama.
w|berdosa.en: Doing harm is considered sinful in religion.

w|berdua.en: Let's just go the two of us.
The two of them sat in the park.

w|bereaksi.text: Murid-murid bereaksi heboh ketika kepala sekolah mengumumkan libur tambahan.
w|bereaksi.en: The students reacted excitedly when the principal announced an extra holiday.
w|bereaksi.ko: 교장 선생님이 휴일을 하루 더 준다고 발표하자 학생들이 들썩였어요.

w|bereaksi.text: Anjing Siti bereaksi gugup saat masuk rumah yang masih asing.
w|bereaksi.en: Siti's dog reacted nervously when it entered the unfamiliar house.
w|bereaksi.ko: 시티네 개는 낯선 집에 들어가자 불안해했어요.

w|berenang.en: Kids like swimming in the pool.
I learned to swim since childhood.

w|berencana.en: We plan to vacation at the beach.

w|beres.text: Semua urusan sudah beres sebelum malam.
w|beres.en: All matters were settled before night.
w|beres.ko: 모든 일이 밤 전에 다 끝났어.

w|beres.en: Just relax, everything will be fine.

w|berevolusi.text: Rina bercerita bahwa perusahaan lamanya terus berevolusi mengikuti teknologi.
w|berevolusi.en: Rina said her old company kept evolving with technology.
w|berevolusi.ko: 리나는 예전 회사가 기술을 따라 계속 진화했다고 했어요.

w|berevolusi.text: Hotel kecil itu berevolusi menjadi resor besar dalam dua puluh tahun.
w|berevolusi.en: That small hotel evolved into a big resort over twenty years.
w|berevolusi.ko: 그 작은 호텔은 이십 년 만에 큰 리조트로 발전했어요.

w|berfungsi.text: Mesin ini masih berfungsi dengan baik.
Lampu jalan tidak berfungsi sejak kemarin.
w|berfungsi.en: The street light has not functioned since yesterday.

w|bergabung.text: Dia ingin bergabung dengan tim kami.
w|bergabung.en: He wants to join our team.
There's still time to join now.

w|bergantung.en: The result depends on our effort.

w|bergantung.text: Jangan terlalu bergantung pada orang lain.
w|bergantung.en: Don't depend too much on other people.

w|bergaul.text: Anak itu mudah bergaul dengan teman baru.
w|bergaul.en: That child easily socializes with new friends.
w|bergaul.ko: 그 아이는 새 친구와 쉽게 어울려.

w|bergaul.text: Dia jarang bergaul di luar kerja.
w|bergaul.en: He rarely socializes outside of work.
w|bergaul.ko: 그는 일 밖에서 거의 어울리지 않아.

w|bergegas.en: They hurried toward the train station.
Just hurry before the shop closes.

w|bergeser.text: Jadwal pengiriman paket Fajar bergeser dua hari karena libur nasional.
w|bergeser.en: Fajar's delivery schedule shifted two days because of a national holiday.
w|bergeser.ko: 공휴일 때문에 파자르의 택배 배송 일정이 이틀 밀렸어요.

w|bergeser.text: Lestari bergeser sedikit supaya teman di sebelahnya bisa memakai kompor.
w|bergeser.en: Lestari shifted over a little so the friend next to her could use the stove.
w|bergeser.ko: 레스타리는 옆 친구가 가스레인지를 쓸 수 있게 조금 비켜섰어요.

w|bergetar.text: Suara Rina bergetar waktu dia menuduh Budi mengambil uangnya.
w|bergetar.en: Rina's voice trembled when she accused Budi of taking her money.
w|bergetar.ko: 리나는 부디가 돈을 가져갔다고 따질 때 목소리가 떨렸어요.

w|bergetar.text: Lantai rumah lama Siti bergetar setiap kali truk lewat.
w|bergetar.en: The floor of Siti's old house shook every time a truck passed.
w|bergetar.ko: 시티의 예전 집은 트럭이 지나갈 때마다 바닥이 흔들렸어요.

w|bergoyang.text: Rudi ingat mereka bergoyang mengikuti lagu dangdut di pesta pernikahan kakak Bayu.
w|bergoyang.en: Rudi remembers them swaying to dangdut songs at Bayu's sister's wedding.
w|bergoyang.ko: 루디는 바유 누나의 결혼식에서 둘이 당둣 노래에 맞춰 몸을 흔들던 걸 기억해요.

w|bergoyang.text: Saat ada gempa kecil, monitor di meja Rina sempat bergoyang.
w|bergoyang.en: During a small earthquake, the monitor on Rina's desk swayed for a moment.
w|bergoyang.ko: 작은 지진이 났을 때 리나 책상 위 모니터가 잠깐 흔들렸어요.

w|berhadapan.text: Dia berhadapan dengan lawan yang tangguh.
Dua tim berhadapan di final yang menegangkan.
w|berhadapan.en: Two teams faced each other in a tense final.

w|berhak.en: Every citizen is entitled to receive education.
w|berhak.ko: 모든 시민은 교육을 받을 권리가 있어.

w|berhak.text: Dia berhak menolak permintaan yang tidak adil.
w|berhak.en: She has the right to refuse an unfair request.
w|berhak.ko: 그는 불공정한 요청을 거절할 권리가 있어.

w|berhalusinasi.text: Setelah berjam-jam di bawah terik matahari, Eko merasa seperti berhalusinasi.
w|berhalusinasi.en: After hours under the blazing sun, Eko felt as if he were hallucinating.
w|berhalusinasi.ko: 몇 시간이나 뙤약볕 아래 있었더니 에코는 환각을 보는 것 같았어요.

w|berhalusinasi.text: Kakek di sebelah rumah Ayu kadang berhalusinasi karena demam tinggi.
w|berhalusinasi.en: The old man next door to Ayu sometimes hallucinates because of a high fever.
w|berhalusinasi.ko: 아유네 옆집 할아버지는 고열 때문에 가끔 헛것을 봐요.

w|berhati-hati.en: Be careful on the slippery road.

w|berhubungan.en: That is related to this case.

w|berhutang.en: He still owes a lot of money.
w|berhutang.ko: 그는 아직 돈을 많이 빚지고 있어.

w|berhutang.en: Owing money to a friend makes me embarrassed.

w|berikut.en: The following is the list of participants.

w|berikutnya.en: Next we'll discuss the money issue.

w|berisi.text: Kotak hadiah berisi buku dan pena.
w|berisi.en: The gift box contains a book and a pen.
w|berisi.ko: 선물 상자에 책과 펜이 들어 있어.

w|berisik.text: Ruangan itu terlalu berisik untuk belajar.
w|berisik.en: That room is too noisy for studying.
The old machine sounds very noisy.

w|beristirahat.en: We need to rest for a moment.

w|berjaga-jaga.text: Eko membawa jas hujan untuk berjaga-jaga kalau badai datang.
w|berjaga-jaga.en: Eko brought a raincoat just in case a storm came.
w|berjaga-jaga.ko: 에코는 폭풍이 올 경우를 대비해 우비를 챙겼어요.

w|berjaga-jaga.text: Bapak-bapak di kompleks Ayu bergiliran berjaga-jaga di pos ronda.
w|berjaga-jaga.en: The men in Ayu's complex take turns keeping watch at the guard post.
w|berjaga-jaga.ko: 아유네 단지 아저씨들은 돌아가며 초소에서 경비를 서요.

w|berjalan-jalan.text: Setiap pagi Agus suka berjalan-jalan di sekitar penginapan.
w|berjalan-jalan.en: Every morning Agus likes to take a walk around the guesthouse.
w|berjalan-jalan.ko: 아구스는 아침마다 숙소 주변을 산책하는 걸 좋아해요.

w|berjalan-jalan.text: Pada hari Minggu banyak keluarga datang hanya untuk berjalan-jalan di mal.
w|berjalan-jalan.en: On Sundays many families come just to stroll around the mall.
w|berjalan-jalan.ko: 일요일에는 그냥 쇼핑몰을 구경하러 오는 가족이 많아요.

w|berjam-jam.text: Bayu berjam-jam menunggu teknisi internet yang tak kunjung datang.
w|berjam-jam.en: Bayu waited for hours for the internet technician, who never showed up.
w|berjam-jam.ko: 바유는 끝내 오지 않는 인터넷 기사를 몇 시간이나 기다렸어요.

w|berjam-jam.text: Kereta itu tertahan berjam-jam karena ada pohon tumbang di rel.
w|berjam-jam.en: The train was held up for hours because a tree had fallen on the tracks.
w|berjam-jam.ko: 선로에 나무가 쓰러져서 기차가 몇 시간이나 멈춰 있었어요.

w|berjanji.text: Berjanji itu mudah, menepatinya yang sulit.
w|berjanji.en: Promising is easy; keeping it is hard.

w|berjaya.text: Tim futsal penghuni gedung Bayu berjaya dalam turnamen antarapartemen.
w|berjaya.en: The futsal team of residents from Bayu's building triumphed in the inter-apartment tournament.
w|berjaya.ko: 바유네 건물 입주민 풋살팀이 아파트 대항 대회에서 이겼어요.

w|berjaya.text: Intan membaca brosur tentang kerajaan yang dulu berjaya di Jawa Timur.
w|berjaya.en: Intan read a brochure about a kingdom that once flourished in East Java.
w|berjaya.ko: 인탄은 예전에 동부 자와에서 번성했던 왕국에 관한 안내 책자를 읽었어요.

w|berjudi.text: Paman Fajar dulu kehilangan tokonya karena suka berjudi.
w|berjudi.en: Fajar's uncle once lost his shop because he liked to gamble.
w|berjudi.ko: 파자르의 삼촌은 도박을 좋아해서 가게를 잃은 적이 있어요.

w|berjudi.text: Beberapa penonton berjudi soal siapa yang akan finis pertama.
w|berjudi.en: Some spectators gambled on who would finish first.
w|berjudi.ko: 몇몇 관중은 누가 일등으로 들어올지 내기를 했어요.

w|berjumpa.text: Kami berjumpa lagi setelah lama tidak bertemu.
w|berjumpa.en: We met again after not seeing each other for a long time.
w|berjumpa.ko: 우리는 오래 못 본 뒤에 다시 만났어.

w|berjumpa.en: She hopes to meet her mentor.

w|berkah.text: Kepala sekolah bilang hujan setelah kemarau panjang itu sebuah berkah.

w|berkah.ko: 교장 선생님은 긴 가뭄 끝에 온 비가 축복이라고 했어요.

w|berkah.text: Bisa berkumpul lengkap di rumah adalah berkah bagi keluarga Ayu.
w|berkah.en: Being able to gather all together at home is a blessing for Ayu's family.
w|berkah.ko: 집에 다 같이 모일 수 있다는 게 아유네 가족에게는 축복이에요.

w|berkaitan.text: Keluhan warga minggu ini kebanyakan berkaitan dengan sampah.
w|berkaitan.en: Most of this week's resident complaints are related to rubbish.
w|berkaitan.ko: 이번 주 주민 민원은 대부분 쓰레기와 관련돼 있어요.

w|berkaitan.text: Pelajaran teori minggu ini berkaitan dengan tangga nada minor.
w|berkaitan.en: This week's theory lesson is related to minor scales.
w|berkaitan.ko: 이번 주 이론 수업은 단음계와 관련 있어요.

w|berkali-kali.text: Dimas sudah membaca novel detektif itu berkali-kali.
w|berkali-kali.en: Dimas has read that detective novel many times.
w|berkali-kali.ko: 디마스는 그 추리 소설을 여러 번 읽었어요.

w|berkali-kali.text: Kereta berhenti berkali-kali di stasiun kecil sepanjang jalur selatan.
w|berkali-kali.en: The train stopped many times at small stations along the southern line.
w|berkali-kali.ko: 기차는 남쪽 노선의 작은 역마다 여러 번 섰어요.

w|berkas.text: Meja Bayu penuh berkas laporan yang harus ditandatangani.
w|berkas.en: Bayu's desk is full of report files that need signing.
w|berkas.ko: 바유의 책상에는 서명해야 할 보고서 서류가 가득해요.

w|berkas.text: Intan menyimpan berkas visa di map plastik supaya tidak kusut.
w|berkas.en: Intan keeps her visa documents in a plastic folder so they don't get creased.
w|berkas.ko: 인탄은 비자 서류가 구겨지지 않게 비닐 파일에 넣어 둬요.

w|berkat.en: We succeeded thanks to our friends' help.
Thanks to hard work, the result is satisfying.

w|berkelahi.text: Dua anak itu berkelahi di halaman sekolah.
w|berkelahi.en: Those two kids fought in the schoolyard.
w|berkelahi.ko: 그 두 아이가 학교 마당에서 싸웠어.

w|berkelahi.en: Don't fight just because of a misunderstanding.

w|berkelakuan.text: Anak-anak di gedung itu berkelakuan baik di dekat kolam renang.
w|berkelakuan.en: The children in that building behave well near the swimming pool.
w|berkelakuan.ko: 그 건물 아이들은 수영장 근처에서 얌전히 행동해요.

w|berkelakuan.text: Petugas menegur penumpang yang berkelakuan kasar kepada pedagang asongan.
w|berkelakuan.en: The officer reprimanded a passenger who behaved rudely to a street vendor.
w|berkelakuan.ko: 직원이 행상에게 무례하게 군 승객을 나무랐어요.

w|berkeliaran.text: Anjing itu berkeliaran di sekitar rumah.
w|berkeliaran.en: That dog wandered around the house.

w|berkeliaran.text: Jangan berkeliaran terlalu jauh di malam hari.
w|berkeliaran.en: Don't wander too far at night.

w|berkeliling.en: We went around the city by bicycle.
She likes to wander around the market early.
w|berkeliling.ko: 그녀는 아침 일찍 시장을 돌아다니는 걸 좋아해.

w|berkemah.text: Malam itu Agus dan teman-temannya berkemah di bawah bintang.
w|berkemah.en: That night Agus and his friends camped under the stars.
w|berkemah.ko: 그날 밤 아구스와 친구들은 별 아래에서 캠핑했어요.

w|berkemah.text: Pelanggan yang hobi berkemah biasanya langsung naik ke lantai empat.
w|berkemah.en: Customers who love camping usually go straight up to the fourth floor.
w|berkemah.ko: 캠핑을 좋아하는 손님들은 보통 바로 사 층으로 올라가요.

w|berkemas.text: Malam sebelum berangkat, Agus berkemas sampai jam satu pagi.
w|berkemas.en: The night before leaving, Agus packed until one in the morning.
w|berkemas.ko: 떠나기 전날 밤, 아구스는 새벽 한 시까지 짐을 쌌어요.

w|berkemas.text: Wati membantu pembeli berkemas sebelum mereka pindah ke luar kota.
w|berkemas.en: Wati helped a customer pack before they moved out of town.
w|berkemas.ko: 와티는 다른 도시로 이사하는 손님의 짐 싸는 걸 도와줬어요.

w|berkembang.text: Kota kecil itu terus berkembang pesat.
w|berkembang.en: That small town keeps developing rapidly.
w|berkembang.ko: 그 작은 도시가 계속 빠르게 발전해.

w|berkembang.en: The growth of the business keeps her busy.

w|berkenalan.text: Andi berkenalan dengan Rina pada hari pertama Rina masuk kerja.
w|berkenalan.en: Andi got acquainted with Rina on her first day at work.
w|berkenalan.ko: 안디는 리나가 출근한 첫날 리나와 인사를 나눴어요.

w|berkenalan.en: Dewi gets to know lots of people from different cities at the reception desk.
w|berkenalan.ko: 데위는 프런트에서 여러 도시에서 온 많은 사람과 알게 돼요.

w|berkencan.text: Mereka mulai berkencan musim panas lalu.
Berkencan butuh kejujuran dari kedua pihak.
w|berkencan.en: Dating needs honesty from both sides.

w|berkendara.text: Dia suka berkendara di jalan pantai.
w|berkendara.en: She likes driving along the coastal road.
w|berkendara.ko: 그는 해안 도로를 운전하는 걸 좋아해.

w|berkendara.text: Berkendara malam hari membutuhkan konsentrasi tinggi.
w|berkendara.en: Driving at night needs high concentration.

w|berkeringat.text: Telapak tangan Agus berkeringat saat duduk di kursi periksa.
w|berkeringat.en: Agus's palms were sweating as he sat in the dental chair.
w|berkeringat.ko: 진료 의자에 앉자 아구스의 손바닥에 땀이 났어요.

w|berkeringat.text: Wati berkeringat deras saat membongkar lantai keramik di siang bolong.
w|berkeringat.en: Wati sweated heavily ripping up the ceramic floor in the midday heat.
w|berkeringat.ko: 와티는 한낮에 타일 바닥을 뜯어내느라 땀을 뻘뻘 흘렸어요.

w|berkomitmen.text: Budi berkomitmen untuk tidak lagi membakar jerami setelah panen.
w|berkomitmen.en: Budi has committed to no longer burning straw after the harvest.
w|berkomitmen.ko: 부디는 추수 뒤에 더 이상 볏짚을 태우지 않기로 다짐했어요.

w|berkomitmen.text: Siti berkomitmen untuk menyelesaikan film ini meskipun jadwalnya padat.
w|berkomitmen.en: Siti is committed to finishing this film even though her schedule is packed.
w|berkomitmen.ko: 시티는 일정이 빡빡해도 이 영화를 끝까지 마치기로 했어요.

w|berkomunikasi.en: It is important to communicate clearly.

w|berkorban.text: Ibu Agus rela berkorban waktu kerja untuk menemaninya ke klinik.
w|berkorban.en: Agus's mother was willing to give up work time to go with him to the clinic.
w|berkorban.ko: 아구스의 어머니는 일하는 시간을 내서 기꺼이 치과에 같이 와 줬어요.

w|berkorban.text: Wati rela berkorban tabungannya demi menyelamatkan rumah peninggalan keluarga.
w|berkorban.en: Wati was willing to sacrifice her savings to save the family house.
w|berkorban.ko: 와티는 집안에서 물려받은 집을 지키려고 기꺼이 저금을 털었어요.

w|berkuasa.text: Raja itu berkuasa selama puluhan tahun.
w|berkuasa.ko: 그 왕이 수십 년 동안 권력을 가졌어.

w|berkuasa.text: Siapa yang berkuasa di wilayah ini?
w|berkuasa.en: Who is in power in this region?
w|berkuasa.ko: 이 지역에서 누가 권력을 잡고 있어?

w|berkumpul.text: Teman-teman berkumpul di taman sore ini.
w|berkumpul.en: Friends are gathering in the park this afternoon.

w|berkumpul.text: Mari berkumpul di depan gerbang sekolah.
w|berkumpul.en: Let's gather in front of the school gate.

w|berkunjung.text: Mereka berkunjung ke rumah nenek kemarin.
Wisatawan berkunjung ke museum setiap hari.
w|berkunjung.en: Tourists visit the museum every day.

w|berkurang.text: Hukuman terdakwa berkurang karena dia mau bekerja sama dengan polisi.
w|berkurang.en: The defendant's sentence was reduced because he agreed to cooperate with the police.
w|berkurang.ko: 피고인은 경찰에 협조하기로 해서 형량이 줄었어요.

w|berkurang.text: Stok beras Lestari berkurang drastis menjelang akhir bulan.
w|berkurang.en: Lestari's rice stock drops sharply towards the end of the month.
w|berkurang.ko: 월말이 다가오면 레스타리 가게의 쌀 재고가 크게 줄어요.

w|berlaku.en: The new rule takes effect tomorrow.

w|berlaku.text: Tiket ini berlaku sampai akhir bulan.
w|berlaku.en: This ticket is valid until the end of the month.

w|berlalu.text: Waktu berlalu begitu cepat tahun ini.
w|berlalu.en: Time has passed so quickly this year.

w|berlalu.text: Mobil itu berlalu tanpa berhenti sebentar.
w|berlalu.en: That car passed by without stopping at all.
w|berlalu.ko: 그 차는 잠깐도 멈추지 않고 지나갔어.

w|berlangsung.en: The match lasted for two hours.

w|berlangsung.text: Rapat penting sedang berlangsung di lantai atas.
w|berlangsung.en: An important meeting is taking place upstairs.

w|berlanjut.en: The meeting continued after a short break.

w|berlanjut.text: Masalah itu berlanjut tanpa solusi jelas.
w|berlanjut.en: That problem continued without a clear solution.
w|berlanjut.ko: 그 문제는 분명한 해결책 없이 계속됐어.

w|berlapis.text: Paket kaca itu dibungkus plastik gelembung berlapis supaya tidak pecah.
w|berlapis.en: The glass parcel was wrapped in layered bubble wrap so it wouldn't break.
w|berlapis.ko: 유리 택배는 깨지지 않게 뽁뽁이로 여러 겹 싸여 있었어요.

w|berlapis.text: Hari ini Lestari belajar membuat kue lapis berlapis sembilan.
w|berlapis.en: Today Lestari is learning to make a nine-layer layered cake.
w|berlapis.ko: 오늘 레스타리는 아홉 겹짜리 레이어 케이크 만드는 법을 배워요.

w|berlari.text: Anjing Dimas berlari menggiring domba-domba ke kandang.
w|berlari.en: Dimas's dog ran, herding the sheep into the pen.
w|berlari.ko: 디마스의 개가 뛰어다니며 양 떼를 우리로 몰았어요.

w|berlari.text: Putri berlari mengejar bus yang hampir berangkat.
w|berlari.en: Putri ran to catch the bus that was about to leave.
w|berlari.ko: 푸트리는 막 떠나려는 버스를 잡으려고 뛰었어요.

w|berlayar.en: The ship will sail tomorrow morning.

w|berlayar.text: Mereka suka berlayar di laut tenang.
w|berlayar.en: They like to sail on a calm sea.
w|berlayar.ko: 그들은 잔잔한 바다에서 항해하는 걸 좋아해.

w|berlebihan.text: Berlebihan gula membuat teh terlalu manis.
w|berlebihan.en: Too much sugar makes the tea too sweet.

w|berlian.text: Berlian itu berkilau di bawah cahaya.
w|berlian.en: That diamond sparkled under the light.

w|berlian.text: Dia memakai cincin berlian di jari.
w|berlian.en: She wore a diamond ring on her finger.

w|berlibur.text: Sudah lama Agus ingin berlibur tanpa rencana yang kaku.
w|berlibur.en: Agus had long wanted to go on holiday without a rigid plan.
w|berlibur.ko: 아구스는 오래전부터 빡빡한 계획 없이 휴가를 떠나고 싶었어요.

w|berlibur.text: Banyak keluarga membeli baju renang sebelum berlibur ke Bali.
w|berlibur.en: Many families buy swimsuits before going on holiday to Bali.
w|berlibur.ko: 많은 가족이 발리로 휴가 가기 전에 수영복을 사요.

w|berlindung.text: Warga berlindung di bawah jembatan saat hujan.
w|berlindung.en: Residents took shelter under the bridge in the rain.

w|berlindung.text: Anak-anak berlindung di balik punggung ibunya.
w|berlindung.en: The children hid behind their mother's back.

w|berlomba.text: Dua anak anjing berlomba mengejar bola di ruang tunggu.
w|berlomba.en: Two puppies raced to chase the ball in the waiting room.
w|berlomba.ko: 강아지 두 마리가 대기실에서 공을 쫓아 경주했어요.

w|berlomba.text: Banyak tim berlomba menemukan obat untuk penyakit itu.
w|berlomba.en: Many teams are racing to find a cure for that disease.
w|berlomba.ko: 많은 팀이 그 병의 치료제를 찾으려고 경쟁하고 있어요.

w|berlutut.en: He knelt down to tie his shoes.
w|berlutut.ko: 그는 신발 끈을 매려고 무릎을 꿇었어.

w|berlutut.en: They knelt in front of the altar.

w|bermain-main.en: The children are playing around in the yard.
Don't play around with people's feelings.

w|bermakna.text: Bagi Budi, hujan pertama setelah kemarau selalu terasa bermakna.
w|bermakna.en: For Budi, the first rain after the dry season always feels meaningful.
w|bermakna.ko: 부디에게 건기 뒤 첫 비는 늘 의미 있게 느껴져요.

w|bermakna.text: Adegan perpisahan di stasiun itu paling bermakna bagi Siti.
w|bermakna.en: The farewell scene at the station was the most meaningful to Siti.
w|bermakna.ko: 역에서의 이별 장면이 시티에게 가장 의미 있었어요.

w|bermaksud.en: I didn't mean it that way.

w|bermanfaat.text: Air hujan yang Budi tampung sangat bermanfaat saat kemarau.
w|bermanfaat.en: The rainwater Budi collects is very useful in the dry season.
w|bermanfaat.ko: 부디가 받아 둔 빗물은 건기에 아주 쓸모가 있어요.

w|bermanfaat.text: Masukan dari pelatih akting sangat bermanfaat bagi Siti.
w|bermanfaat.en: The acting coach's feedback was very helpful to Siti.
w|bermanfaat.ko: 연기 코치의 조언은 시티에게 큰 도움이 됐어요.

w|bermasalah.text: Proyek menjadi bermasalah setelah hujan deras.
w|bermasalah.en: The project became troubled after heavy rain.

w|bermimpi.en: Last night I dreamed about the sea.

w|bermimpi.text: Anak itu sering bermimpi menjadi pilot.
w|bermimpi.en: That child often dreams of becoming a pilot.
w|bermimpi.ko: 그 아이는 자주 조종사가 되는 꿈을 꿔.

w|berminat.text: Rudi bertanya apakah Bayu masih berminat belajar fotografi.
w|berminat.en: Rudi asked whether Bayu is still interested in learning photography.
w|berminat.ko: 루디는 바유가 아직 사진을 배우고 싶은지 물었어요.

w|berminat.text: Dua perusahaan besar berminat membeli saham perusahaan Rina.
w|berminat.en: Two large companies are interested in buying shares in Rina's company.
w|berminat.ko: 대기업 두 곳이 리나 회사의 지분을 사고 싶어 해요.

w|bermoral.text: Bayu percaya pemimpin yang baik harus jujur dan bermoral.
w|bermoral.en: Bayu believes a good leader must be honest and have good morals.
w|bermoral.ko: 바유는 좋은 리더라면 정직하고 도덕적이어야 한다고 믿어요.

w|bermoral.text: Di majalah pesawat ada cerita tentang tokoh yang bermoral tinggi.
w|bermoral.en: The in-flight magazine has a story about a person of high morals.
w|bermoral.ko: 기내 잡지에 도덕성이 높은 인물 이야기가 실려 있어요.

w|bermula.text: Usaha roti Fajar bermula dari dapur kecil di rumah ibunya.
w|bermula.en: Fajar's bread business started in a small kitchen at his mother's house.
w|bermula.ko: 파자르의 빵 사업은 어머니 집의 작은 부엌에서 시작됐어요.

w|bermula.text: Kecintaan Lestari pada lari bermula dari lomba kecil di sekolah.
w|bermula.en: Lestari's love of running began with a small race at school.
w|bermula.ko: 레스타리의 달리기 사랑은 학교의 작은 대회에서 시작됐어요.

w|bernapas.text: Tarik napas dalam dan bernapas pelan.
w|bernapas.en: Take a deep breath and breathe slowly.
He had trouble breathing after running.

w|bernegosiasi.text: Mandor harus bernegosiasi dengan pemasok soal harga besi.
w|bernegosiasi.en: The foreman had to negotiate with the supplier over the price of steel.
w|bernegosiasi.ko: 십장은 철근 값을 두고 납품업자와 협상해야 했어요.

w|bernegosiasi.text: Rina sempat bernegosiasi soal gaji sebelum menandatangani kontrak.
w|bernegosiasi.en: Rina negotiated her salary before signing the contract.
w|bernegosiasi.ko: 리나는 계약서에 서명하기 전에 연봉 협상을 했어요.

w|berniat.text: Saya berniat pindah ke kota lain.
w|berniat.en: I intend to move to another city.
Good intentions alone are not enough.

w|bernilai.text: Pengalaman ini bernilai bagi masa depanmu.
w|bernilai.en: This experience is valuable for your future.
w|bernilai.ko: 이 경험은 네 미래에 가치 있어.

w|bernyanyi.en: The children are singing on stage.

w|beroperasi.text: Mesin cetak koran itu beroperasi sepanjang malam.
w|beroperasi.en: The newspaper's printing press runs all night.

w|beroperasi.text: Toko servis Ayu beroperasi dari pagi sampai jam sembilan malam.
w|beroperasi.en: Ayu's repair shop operates from morning until nine at night.
w|beroperasi.ko: 아유의 수리점은 아침부터 밤 아홉 시까지 문을 열어요.

w|berpakaian.en: The children are getting dressed for school.
w|berpakaian.ko: 아이들이 학교 갈 옷을 입고 있어.

w|berpakaian.text: Dia berpakaian rapi sebelum wawancara kerja.
w|berpakaian.en: He dressed neatly before the job interview.

w|berpaling.text: Budi tidak berpaling dari papan tulis selama Pak Hadi menjelaskan rumus.
w|berpaling.en: Budi didn't turn away from the whiteboard while Mr. Hadi explained the formula.
w|berpaling.ko: 하디 선생님이 공식을 설명하는 동안 부디는 칠판에서 눈을 떼지 않았어요.

w|berpaling.text: Siti berpaling sekali lagi ke rumah lamanya sebelum masuk mobil.
w|berpaling.en: Siti turned back to look at her old house once more before getting into the car.
w|berpaling.ko: 시티는 차에 타기 전에 옛집을 한 번 더 돌아봤어요.

w|berpegangan.text: Waktu kecil, Budi dan Rina selalu berpegangan tangan saat menyeberang jalan.
w|berpegangan.en: As children, Budi and Rina always held hands when crossing the street.
w|berpegangan.ko: 어렸을 때 부디와 리나는 길을 건널 때 늘 손을 잡았어요.

w|berpegangan.text: Anak-anak Siti berpegangan pada pagar tangga yang belum dicat.
w|berpegangan.en: Siti's children held onto the unpainted stair railing.
w|berpegangan.ko: 시티의 아이들은 아직 칠하지 않은 계단 난간을 붙잡았어요.

w|berpencar.text: Setelah apel pagi, para tukang berpencar ke bagian masing-masing.
w|berpencar.en: After the morning briefing, the builders spread out to their own sections.
w|berpencar.ko: 아침 조회가 끝나자 인부들은 각자 맡은 곳으로 흩어졌어요.

w|berpencar.text: Saat jam makan siang, para karyawan berpencar mencari warung favorit masing-masing.
w|berpencar.en: At lunchtime, the employees scattered to find their favourite food stalls.
w|berpencar.ko: 점심시간이 되자 직원들은 각자 좋아하는 식당을 찾아 흩어졌어요.

w|berpengalaman.text: Mandor lebih percaya pada tukang yang berpengalaman untuk memasang rangka atap.
w|berpengalaman.en: The foreman trusts experienced builders more to put up the roof frame.
w|berpengalaman.ko: 십장은 지붕 뼈대를 올리는 일은 경험 많은 인부를 더 믿어요.

w|berpengalaman.text: Rina dibimbing oleh analis berpengalaman selama tiga bulan pertama.
w|berpengalaman.en: Rina is mentored by an experienced analyst for her first three months.
w|berpengalaman.ko: 리나는 처음 석 달 동안 경험 많은 분석가에게 지도를 받아요.

w|berpengaruh.text: Menurut Dimas, makanan yang terlalu asin sangat berpengaruh pada kesehatan ginjal kucing.
w|berpengaruh.en: According to Dimas, overly salty food has a big effect on a cat's kidney health.
w|berpengaruh.ko: 디마스 말로는 너무 짠 음식이 고양이 콩팥 건강에 큰 영향을 줘요.

w|berpengaruh.text: Suhu ruangan ternyata berpengaruh besar pada hasil percobaan.
w|berpengaruh.en: The room temperature turned out to have a big effect on the experiment's results.
w|berpengaruh.ko: 알고 보니 실내 온도가 실험 결과에 큰 영향을 줬어요.

w|berperang.en: Going to war is not the only way out.

w|berperilaku.text: Anak-anak yang berperilaku baik selama diperiksa mendapat stiker dari perawat.
w|berperilaku.en: Children who behave well during the check-up get a sticker from the nurse.
w|berperilaku.ko: 진료 중에 얌전히 있는 아이들은 간호사에게 스티커를 받아요.

w|berperilaku.text: Kucing liar di halaman mulai berperilaku jinak sejak Wati memberinya makan.
w|berperilaku.en: The stray cat in the yard has started behaving tamely since Wati began feeding it.
w|berperilaku.ko: 와티가 먹이를 준 뒤로 마당의 길고양이가 순하게 굴기 시작했어요.

w|berpesta.en: They partied until late at night.

w|berpesta.text: Berpesta di rumah tetangga terdengar gaduh.
w|berpesta.en: Partying at the neighbor's house sounded loud.

w|berpikiran.text: Andi senang punya rekan yang berpikiran terbuka seperti Rina.
w|berpikiran.en: Andi is glad to have an open-minded coworker like Rina.
w|berpikiran.ko: 안디는 리나처럼 생각이 열린 동료가 있어서 좋아요.

w|berpikiran.text: Manajer Dewi berpikiran bahwa layanan cepat lebih penting dari lobi mewah.
w|berpikiran.en: Dewi's manager thinks fast service matters more than a fancy lobby.
w|berpikiran.ko: 데위의 매니저는 화려한 로비보다 빠른 서비스가 더 중요하다고 생각해요.

w|berpindah.text: Setiap minggu kambing-kambing Dimas berpindah ke padang rumput yang lain.
w|berpindah.en: Every week Dimas's goats move to a different pasture.
w|berpindah.ko: 디마스의 염소들은 매주 다른 풀밭으로 옮겨 가요.

w|berpindah.text: Putri berpindah ke kursi dekat jendela supaya lebih terang.
w|berpindah.en: Putri moved to the seat by the window so it would be brighter.
w|berpindah.ko: 푸트리는 더 밝은 창가 자리로 옮겨 앉았어요.

w|berpisah.text: Mereka berpisah di stasiun dengan sedih.
w|berpisah.en: They parted at the station sadly.
Parting for a while does not mean it ends.

w|berpura-pura.en: He pretended not to hear my call.
w|berpura-pura.ko: 그는 내 부름을 못 들은 척했어.

w|berpura-pura.en: Pretending to be sick so he can take time off.
w|berpura-pura.ko: 쉴 수 있게 아픈 척하는 거야.

w|berputar.en: That wheel is spinning very fast.

w|berputar.text: Kepalaku berputar setelah naik komidi putar.
w|berputar.en: My head spun after riding the merry-go-round.
w|berputar.ko: 회전목을 탄 뒤에 머리가 빙빙 돌았어.

w|bersabar.text: Agus meminta warga di ruang tunggu untuk bersabar sebentar.
w|bersabar.en: Agus asked the residents in the waiting room to be patient for a moment.
w|bersabar.ko: 아구스는 대기실 주민들에게 조금만 기다려 달라고 했어요.

w|bersabar.text: Guru piano meminta Wati bersabar karena tangan kirinya butuh waktu untuk terbiasa.
w|bersabar.en: The piano teacher asked Wati to be patient because her left hand needs time to get used to it.
w|bersabar.ko: 피아노 선생님은 왼손이 익숙해지려면 시간이 걸린다며 와티에게 참으라고 했어요.

w|bersahabat.text: Warga sekitar proyek cukup bersahabat dan sering mengantar kopi.
w|bersahabat.en: The residents around the site are quite friendly and often bring coffee.
w|bersahabat.ko: 현장 주변 주민들은 꽤 친절해서 커피를 자주 가져다줘요.

w|bersahabat.text: Suasana kantor baru Rina ternyata sangat bersahabat.
w|bersahabat.en: The atmosphere at Rina's new office turned out to be very friendly.
w|bersahabat.ko: 리나의 새 회사 분위기는 알고 보니 아주 화기애애했어요.

w|bersaing.text: Koran cetak sekarang harus bersaing dengan berita di media sosial.
w|bersaing.en: Print newspapers now have to compete with news on social media.
w|bersaing.ko: 종이 신문은 이제 소셜 미디어 뉴스와 경쟁해야 해요.

w|bersaing.text: Toko Ayu harus bersaing dengan pusat servis resmi di mal.
w|bersaing.en: Ayu's shop has to compete with the official service center at the mall.
w|bersaing.ko: 아유 가게는 쇼핑몰 정식 서비스 센터와 경쟁해야 해요.

w|bersaksi.text: Saksi akan bersaksi di pengadilan besok.
w|bersaksi.en: The witness will testify in court tomorrow.

w|bersaksi.text: Bersaksi jujur adalah kewajiban setiap warga.
w|bersaksi.en: Testifying honestly is every citizen's duty.
w|bersaksi.ko: 정직하게 증언하는 것은 모든 시민의 의무야.

w|bersalah.text: Bersalah atau tidak, kita harus adil.
w|bersalah.en: Guilty or not, we must be fair.

w|bersamaan.text: Mereka tiba di stasiun secara bersamaan.
w|bersamaan.en: They arrived at the station at the same time.

w|bersamaan.text: Dua alarm berbunyi bersamaan tadi pagi.
w|bersamaan.en: Two alarms rang at the same time this morning.
w|bersamaan.ko: 오늘 아침 알람 두 개가 동시에 울렸어.

w|bersantai.text: Mereka bersantai di taman setelah makan siang.
w|bersantai.en: They relaxed in the park after lunch.

w|bersantai.text: Bersantai sejenak membuat pikiran lebih jernih.
w|bersantai.en: Relaxing for a moment clears the mind.
w|bersantai.ko: 잠깐 쉬는 것이 머리를 맑게 해.

w|bersatu.en: They united to solve the problem.

w|bersatu.text: Bersatu kita lebih kuat dari sendiri.
w|bersatu.en: United we are stronger than alone.

w|bersaudara.en: They are siblings even though they rarely meet.

w|bersaudara.text: Kami merasa bersaudara setelah perjalanan panjang itu.
w|bersaudara.en: We felt like siblings after that long journey.
w|bersaudara.ko: 그 긴 여행 뒤 우리는 형제처럼 느꼈어.

w|bersedia.en: I'm willing to help you anytime.

w|bersedih.text: Rudi bersedih ketika mendengar ayah Bayu sudah meninggal.
w|bersedih.en: Rudi grieved when he heard that Bayu's father had passed away.
w|bersedih.ko: 루디는 바유의 아버지가 돌아가셨다는 소식을 듣고 슬퍼했어요.

w|bersedih.text: Rina tidak sempat bersedih meski investor pertama menolak proposalnya.

w|berselingkuh.text: Di kantin, Andi mendengar gosip bahwa manajer lama berselingkuh dengan sekretarisnya.

w|berselingkuh.text: Dalam novel yang Dewi baca di jam istirahat, seorang suami berselingkuh di hotel mewah.
w|berselingkuh.en: In the novel Dewi reads on her break, a husband has an affair at a luxury hotel.
w|berselingkuh.ko: 데위가 쉬는 시간에 읽는 소설에서 한 남편이 호화 호텔에서 바람을 피워요.

w|bersemangat.en: She was so enthusiastic welcoming the guests.

w|bersemangat.text: Tim itu bermain dengan sangat bersemangat.

w|bersenang-senang.en: They're having fun at the beach.

w|bersenjata.en: Fully armed, they entered the forest.
w|bersenjata.ko: 완전 무장한 채로 그들은 숲에 들어갔어.

w|bersenjata.en: That group is known to be armed.
w|bersenjata.ko: 그 무리는 무장한 것으로 알려져 있어.

w|bersih.text: Dimas selalu memastikan air minum ternaknya tetap bersih.
w|bersih.en: Dimas always makes sure his livestock's drinking water stays clean.
w|bersih.ko: 디마스는 늘 가축이 마시는 물이 깨끗한지 확인해요.

w|bersin.ko: 그 고양이는 먼지 알레르기 때문에 계속 재채기를 해요.

w|bersin.ko: 창고 먼지 때문에 푸트리는 여러 번 재채기를 했어요.

w|bersinar.en: The sun is shining brightly this morning.
The shining of the stars adorns the sky.

w|bersorak.ko: 사서가 독서 대회 우승자를 발표하자 아이들이 환호했어요.

w|bersorak.text: Penumpang di gerbong Putri bersorak saat kereta akhirnya berangkat.

w|bersorak.ko: 기차가 마침내 출발하자 푸트리네 칸 승객들이 환호했어요.

w|bersulang.en: Let's toast to a better future.
They toasted after signing the agreement.

w|bersumpah.en: He swore he would be honest.

w|bersyukur.en: He is grateful for his family's support.

w|bersyukur.text: Mari bersyukur atas hari yang aman.
w|bersyukur.en: Let's be grateful for a safe day.

w|bertabrakan.text: Dua perahu nelayan hampir bertabrakan di dekat dermaga karena ombak tinggi.
w|bertabrakan.en: Two fishing boats nearly collided near the pier because of high waves.
w|bertabrakan.ko: 높은 파도 때문에 어선 두 척이 부두 근처에서 부딪칠 뻔했어요.

w|bertabrakan.text: Sepeda anak Ayu dan motor tetangga bertabrakan di gang sempit.
w|bertabrakan.en: Ayu's child's bicycle and the neighbor's motorbike collided in the narrow alley.
w|bertabrakan.ko: 좁은 골목에서 아유네 아이 자전거와 이웃 오토바이가 부딪쳤어요.

w|bertahun-tahun.text: Pak satpam itu sudah bertahun-tahun menjaga gedung apartemen Bayu.
w|bertahun-tahun.en: That security guard has guarded Bayu's apartment building for years.
w|bertahun-tahun.ko: 그 경비원은 몇 년째 바유네 아파트 건물을 지키고 있어요.

w|bertahun-tahun.text: Intan sudah bertahun-tahun memakai jalur kereta yang sama untuk mudik.
w|bertahun-tahun.en: Intan has used the same train route for years to go home for the holidays.
w|bertahun-tahun.ko: 인탄은 몇 년째 같은 기차 노선으로 고향에 가요.

w|bertambah.en: The number of students grows every year.
His weight increased after the holiday.

w|bertanding.text: Penghuni apartemen itu bertanding bulu tangkis di lapangan atap setiap Minggu.
w|bertanding.en: The residents of that apartment building play badminton matches on the rooftop court every Sunday.
w|bertanding.ko: 그 아파트 입주민들은 일요일마다 옥상 코트에서 배드민턴 시합을 해요.

w|bertanding.text: Dua pemuda di gerbong itu sedang menuju Bandung untuk bertanding catur.
w|bertanding.en: Two young men in that carriage were heading to Bandung to compete in chess.
w|bertanding.ko: 그 객차의 두 청년은 체스 시합을 하러 반둥으로 가는 길이었어요.

w|bertanya-tanya.ko: 학생들은 모두 새 수학 선생님이 누구일지 궁금해했어요.

w|bertanya-tanya.text: Ayu bertanya-tanya kenapa kakaknya belum pulang juga.
w|bertanya-tanya.en: Ayu wondered why her older brother still hadn't come home.
w|bertanya-tanya.ko: 아유는 오빠가 왜 아직도 안 오는지 궁금했어요.

w|bertaruh.text: Mereka tidak boleh bertaruh di sini.

w|bertaruh.text: Aku tidak mau bertaruh soal itu.
w|bertaruh.en: I don't want to wager on that.

w|bertekad.ko: 부디는 저녁 먹기 전에 그 오해를 풀겠다고 마음먹었어요.

w|blok.en: That apartment block was just finished.

w|bocor.text: Rahasia kejutan untuk guru wali kelas sempat bocor ke grup obrolan.
w|bocor.en: The secret surprise for the homeroom teacher briefly leaked into the group chat.
w|bocor.ko: 담임 선생님을 위한 깜짝 선물 비밀이 단톡방에 새어 나갈 뻔했어요.

w|bola.en: The kids are playing ball in the park.

w|boneka.en: Her favorite doll went missing in the park.

w|boneka.text: Anak itu memeluk boneka sebelum tidur.
w|boneka.en: The child hugged the doll before sleeping.
w|boneka.ko: 그 아이는 잠들기 전에 인형을 안았어.

w|bonus.text: Para tukang dijanjikan bonus kalau atap selesai sebelum musim hujan.
w|bonus.en: The builders were promised a bonus if the roof is finished before the rainy season.
w|bonus.ko: 인부들은 우기 전에 지붕을 끝내면 보너스를 받기로 했어요.

w|bonus.text: Rina dengar karyawan di sini dapat bonus akhir tahun yang lumayan.
w|bonus.en: Rina heard that employees here get a decent year-end bonus.
w|bonus.ko: 리나는 여기 직원들이 연말 보너스를 꽤 받는다고 들었어요.

w|borgol.text: Dalam adegan penangkapan, Bayu memakai borgol plastik dari gudang properti.
w|borgol.en: In the arrest scene, Bayu wears plastic handcuffs from the props store.
w|borgol.ko: 체포 장면에서 바유는 소품 창고에서 가져온 플라스틱 수갑을 차요.

w|borgol.text: Dodi bercanda bahwa jam kantor terasa seperti borgol yang tidak kelihatan.
w|borgol.en: Dodi joked that office hours feel like invisible handcuffs.
w|borgol.ko: 도디는 근무 시간이 눈에 안 보이는 수갑 같다고 농담했어요.

w|bos.en: He met the boss this morning.

w|bosan.text: Aku bosan menunggu di sini lama-lama.
w|bosan.en: I'm bored of waiting here for so long.

w|bosan.text: Anak itu tampak bosan di kelas.
w|bosan.en: That child looked bored in class.

w|botak.text: Saksi menggambarkan pelaku sebagai pria botak berkacamata hitam.
w|botak.en: The witness described the perpetrator as a bald man wearing dark glasses.
w|botak.ko: 증인은 범인을 선글라스를 쓴 대머리 남자라고 묘사했어요.

w|botak.text: Pak Darto yang botak selalu membeli kopi sachet setiap pagi.
w|botak.en: Bald Mr Darto always buys a sachet of coffee every morning.
w|botak.ko: 대머리인 다르토 아저씨는 매일 아침 봉지 커피를 사요.

w|botol.text: Botol air itu jatuh dari meja.
w|botol.en: That water bottle fell off the table.

w|botol.text: Dia mengisi botol sebelum pergi lari.
w|botol.en: She filled the bottle before going for a run.
w|botol.ko: 그는 달리러 가기 전에 병에 물을 채웠어.

w|brankas.text: Uang gaji disimpan di brankas kantor sampai hari pembayaran.
w|brankas.en: The wage money is kept in the office safe until payday.
w|brankas.ko: 월급 돈은 지급일까지 사무실 금고에 보관돼요.

w|brankas.text: Kamar hotel Intan punya brankas kecil untuk menyimpan paspor.
w|brankas.en: Intan's hotel room has a small safe for keeping her passport.
w|brankas.ko: 인탄의 호텔 방에는 여권을 넣어 둘 작은 금고가 있어요.

w|brilian.text: Ide Budi untuk proyek daur ulang dianggap brilian oleh juri.
w|brilian.en: The judges thought Budi's idea for the recycling project was brilliant.
w|brilian.ko: 심사위원들은 부디의 재활용 프로젝트 아이디어가 기발하다고 봤어요.

w|brilian.text: Ide adik Siti untuk memberi label warna pada setiap kardus ternyata brilian.
w|brilian.en: Siti's younger sibling's idea of color-labeling every box turned out to be brilliant.
w|brilian.ko: 상자마다 색깔 표시를 붙이자는 동생 아이디어는 정말 기발했어요.

w|brutal.text: Dalam pelajaran sejarah, Budi membaca tentang perang brutal di masa penjajahan.
w|brutal.en: In history class, Budi read about a brutal war during the colonial period.
w|brutal.ko: 부디는 역사 시간에 식민지 시대의 잔혹한 전쟁에 대해 읽었어요.

w|brutal.text: Wartawan di antara alumni bercerita tentang liputannya mengenai konflik brutal di luar negeri.
w|brutal.en: A journalist among the alumni talked about covering a brutal conflict abroad.
w|brutal.ko: 동문 중 한 기자가 해외의 참혹한 분쟁을 취재한 이야기를 했어요.

w|buas.text: Jaksa menyebut kasus ini melibatkan perdagangan satwa buas secara ilegal.
w|buas.en: The prosecutor said this case involves the illegal trade of wild animals.
w|buas.ko: 검사는 이 사건이 야생 맹수를 불법으로 거래한 일과 관련 있다고 했어요.

w|buas.text: Anak-anak suka membeli stiker bergambar binatang buas di warung Lestari.
w|buas.en: Children like buying stickers of wild animals at Lestari's shop.
w|buas.ko: 아이들은 레스타리 가게에서 맹수 그림 스티커를 즐겨 사요.

w|buat.en: She made a cake this morning.

w|buatan.text: Kue buatan ibu rasanya enak sekali.
w|buatan.en: The cake Mom made tastes really good.
w|buatan.ko: 엄마가 만든 케이크 맛이 정말 좋아.

w|buatan.text: Ini produk buatan lokal yang bagus.
w|buatan.en: This is a good locally made product.

w|buaya.text: Kata petugas desa, di sungai dekat sawah pernah terlihat buaya.
w|buaya.en: The village officer said a crocodile was once seen in the river near the rice fields.
w|buaya.ko: 마을 담당자 말로는 논 근처 강에서 악어가 목격된 적이 있대요.

w|buaya.text: Adik Putri juga takut melihat buaya yang diam seperti patung.
w|buaya.en: Putri's little sister was also scared of the crocodile that stayed still like a statue.
w|buaya.ko: 푸트리의 동생은 동상처럼 꼼짝 않는 악어도 무서워했어요.

w|bubar.text: Antrean pasien baru bubar setelah klinik tutup pukul delapan malam.
w|bubar.en: The line of patients only cleared after the clinic closed at eight in the evening.
w|bubar.ko: 환자 줄은 치과가 저녁 여덟 시에 문을 닫고 나서야 흩어졌어요.

w|bubar.text: Para tetangga yang menonton di pagar bubar setelah tembok lama berhasil dirobohkan.
w|bubar.en: The neighbours watching by the fence dispersed after the old wall was knocked down.
w|bubar.ko: 울타리에서 구경하던 이웃들은 옛 벽이 무너지자 흩어졌어요.

w|bubuk.text: Kopi bubuk di dapur redaksi selalu habis sebelum tengah malam.
w|bubuk.en: The ground coffee in the newsroom kitchen always runs out before midnight.
w|bubuk.ko: 편집국 탕비실 분말 커피는 자정 전에 늘 바닥나요.

w|bubuk.text: Ayu memakai bubuk silika untuk mengeringkan ponsel yang kena air.
w|bubuk.en: Ayu uses silica powder to dry phones that got wet.
w|bubuk.ko: 아유는 물에 젖은 휴대폰을 말리려고 실리카 가루를 써요.

w|budak.text: Cerita tentang budak itu sangat menyentuh.
w|budak.en: The story about that slave is very moving.

w|budak.text: Mereka membebaskan budak dari penjara gelap.
w|budak.en: They freed the slave from the dark prison.
w|budak.ko: 그들은 어두운 감옥에서 노예를 풀어 줬어.

w|budaya.text: Budaya lokal dijaga oleh masyarakat desa.
w|budaya.en: Local culture is preserved by the village community.

w|budaya.text: Dia mempelajari budaya Jepang dengan tekun.

w|budi.text: Eko tidak akan melupakan budi baik guru yang membantunya waktu sakit.
w|budi.en: Eko will never forget the kindness of the teacher who helped him when he was sick.
w|budi.ko: 에코는 아플 때 자기를 도와준 선생님의 은혜를 잊지 않을 거예요.

w|budi.text: Ibu Ayu selalu mengajarkan anak-anaknya untuk membalas budi orang yang menolong mereka.
w|budi.en: Ayu's mother always teaches her children to repay the kindness of people who help them.
w|budi.ko: 아유의 어머니는 늘 아이들에게 도와준 사람의 은혜를 갚으라고 가르쳐요.

w|bukit.text: Kami mendaki bukit sebelum matahari terbit.
w|bukit.en: We climbed the hill before sunrise.
w|bukit.ko: 우리는 해 뜨기 전에 언덕을 올랐어.

w|bukit.text: Bukit hijau itu tampak dari jendela.
w|bukit.en: That green hill is visible from the window.

w|buku.en: I forgot to bring the book.

w|bulan.en: There are many events this month.
Look at the moon in the night sky.

w|bulat.text: Lubang untuk tiang itu harus benar-benar bulat agar pipa bisa masuk.
w|bulat.en: The hole for the pillar has to be perfectly round so the pipe can fit.
w|bulat.ko: 파이프가 들어가려면 기둥 구멍이 완전히 둥글어야 해요.

w|bulat.text: Rapat perkenalan Rina diadakan di meja bulat dekat jendela.
w|bulat.en: Rina's introduction meeting was held at the round table by the window.
w|bulat.ko: 리나의 첫인사 회의는 창가의 둥근 탁자에서 열렸어요.

w|bulu.en: That cat's fur is very soft.
There is fur on her black coat.

w|bumi.en: We have to protect the earth.

w|bunga.en: The flowers in the garden bloomed.

w|buntu.text: Diskusi kelompok Budi sempat buntu karena tidak ada yang mau mengalah.
w|buntu.en: Budi's group discussion hit a dead end because no one would give in.
w|buntu.ko: 아무도 양보하지 않아서 부디네 조 토론이 한동안 막혔어요.

w|buntu.text: Rumah lama Siti ada di ujung gang buntu dekat sekolah.
w|buntu.en: Siti's old house is at the end of a dead-end alley near the school.
w|buntu.ko: 시티의 옛집은 학교 근처 막다른 골목 끝에 있어요.

w|bunyi.en: The school bell sound rang loudly.

w|bunyi.text: Aku mendengar bunyi aneh dari dapur.
w|bunyi.en: I heard a strange sound from the kitchen.

w|buronan.text: Klub drama Eko memainkan cerita tentang seorang buronan yang akhirnya menyerah.
w|buronan.en: Eko's drama club performed a story about a fugitive who finally gives himself up.
w|buronan.ko: 에코네 연극부는 끝내 자수하는 도망자 이야기를 공연했어요.

w|buronan.text: Keluarga Ayu menonton film tentang detektif yang mengejar buronan.
w|buronan.en: Ayu's family watched a film about a detective chasing a fugitive.
w|buronan.ko: 아유네 가족은 탈주범을 쫓는 형사 영화를 봤어요.

w|buru-buru.text: Dia buru-buru pergi karena hampir terlambat.
w|buru-buru.en: He left in a hurry because he was almost late.
w|buru-buru.ko: 거의 늦을 뻔해서 그는 서둘러 떠났어.

w|buru-buru.text: Buru-buru saja, bus sebentar lagi datang.
w|buru-buru.en: Hurry up, the bus will arrive soon.

w|burung.en: That bird sings early in the morning.
There's a bird in the tree.

w|bus.text: Kami naik bus ke pusat kota.
w|bus.en: We took the bus to downtown.
That bus is full of passengers.

w|busuk.text: Buah itu sudah busuk di kulkas.
w|busuk.en: That fruit has already gone rotten in the fridge.

w|busuk.text: Bau busuk datang dari tempat sampah.
w|busuk.en: A rotten smell came from the trash.

w|busur.text: Untuk hobi memanah, Fajar membeli busur kayu dari penjual di Bandung.
w|busur.en: For his archery hobby, Fajar bought a wooden bow from a seller in Bandung.
w|busur.ko: 파자르는 활쏘기 취미 때문에 반둥의 판매자에게서 나무 활을 샀어요.

w|busur.text: Lestari menghias kue ulang tahun dengan bentuk busur dan panah dari cokelat.
w|busur.en: Lestari decorated the birthday cake with a bow and arrow made of chocolate.
w|busur.ko: 레스타리는 생일 케이크를 초콜릿 활과 화살로 장식했어요.

w|buta.en: He has been illiterate since childhood.

w|buta.text: Kucing itu hampir buta di malam hari.
w|buta.en: That cat is almost blind at night.
w|buta.ko: 그 고양이는 밤에 거의 안 보여.

w|cabang.text: Museum nasional membuka cabang baru di kota pesisir.
w|cabang.en: The national museum opened a new branch in a coastal city.
w|cabang.ko: 국립 박물관이 해안 도시에 새 분관을 열었어요.

w|cabang.text: Toko kue langganan Rina sudah punya cabang di tiga pasar.
w|cabang.en: Rina's favorite cake shop already has branches in three markets.
w|cabang.ko: 리나가 단골인 과자 가게는 벌써 시장 세 곳에 지점이 있어요.

w|cacat.text: Produk itu punya cacat kecil di sudut.
w|cacat.en: That product has a small defect in the corner.
w|cacat.ko: 그 제품은 모서리에 작은 흠이 있어.

w|cacat.en: A defect in the machine made it stop.

w|cacing.text: Cacing tanah membantu menyuburkan tanah kebun.
Anak itu takut memegang cacing basah.
w|cacing.en: That child is afraid to hold a wet worm.
w|cacing.ko: 그 아이는 젖은 지렁이 만지기를 무서워해.

w|cadangan.text: Bawa baterai cadangan untuk perjalanan jauh.
w|cadangan.en: Bring a spare battery for a long trip.
The food reserve is stored in the warehouse.

w|cairan.text: Cairan itu harus disimpan di tempat sejuk.
w|cairan.en: That liquid must be stored in a cool place.
w|cairan.ko: 그 액체는 서늘한 곳에 보관해야 해.

w|cairan.text: Dokter menyarankan minum cairan lebih banyak.
w|cairan.en: The doctor advised drinking more fluids.
w|cairan.ko: 의사가 수분을 더 많이 마시라고 했어.

w|cakap.text: Petugas jaga di kantor polisi itu cakap menenangkan warga yang panik.
w|cakap.en: The officer on duty at the police station is skilled at calming panicked residents.
w|cakap.ko: 그 경찰서 당직 경찰관은 겁먹은 주민을 잘 진정시켜요.

w|cakap.text: Dewi dikenal cakap membaca permainan lawan.
w|cakap.en: Dewi is known for being good at reading the opponent's game.
w|cakap.ko: 데위는 상대 팀 경기 흐름을 잘 읽기로 유명해요.

w|cakar.text: Seekor kepiting mengangkat cakar besarnya ketika Eko mendekat.
w|cakar.en: A crab raised its big claw when Eko came near.
w|cakar.ko: 에코가 다가가자 게 한 마리가 큰 집게발을 치켜들었어요.

w|cakar.text: Kucing tetangga meninggalkan bekas cakar di sofa Ayu.
w|cakar.en: The neighbor's cat left claw marks on Ayu's sofa.
w|cakar.ko: 이웃집 고양이가 아유의 소파에 발톱 자국을 남겼어요.

w|calon.text: Calon ketua menyampaikan visi dengan jelas.
w|calon.en: The candidate for chair clearly presented a vision.

w|calon.text: Mereka mendukung calon dari daerah ini.
w|calon.en: They support the candidate from this area.

w|campuran.text: Andi diberi segelas teh campuran jahe sambil menunggu giliran.
w|campuran.en: Andi was given a glass of tea mixed with ginger while waiting his turn.
w|campuran.ko: 안디는 차례를 기다리는 동안 생강을 섞은 차 한 잔을 받았어요.

w|campuran.text: Seragam baru tim dibuat dari kain campuran yang cepat kering.
w|campuran.en: The team's new uniforms are made from a blended fabric that dries quickly.
w|campuran.ko: 팀의 새 유니폼은 빨리 마르는 혼방 원단으로 만들었어요.

w|canggih.text: Teater itu baru memasang sistem tata cahaya yang canggih.
w|canggih.en: The theatre has just installed a sophisticated lighting system.
w|canggih.ko: 그 극장은 최첨단 조명 시스템을 새로 설치했어요.

w|canggih.text: Perusahaan membelikan Intan ponsel canggih untuk urusan kantor.
w|canggih.en: The company bought Intan an advanced phone for work.
w|canggih.ko: 회사가 업무용으로 인탄에게 최신 휴대폰을 사 줬어요.

w|canggung.text: Setelah sepuluh tahun tidak bertemu, Rudi takut pertemuan mereka nanti akan terasa canggung.
w|canggung.en: After ten years apart, Rudi was afraid their meeting would feel awkward.
w|canggung.ko: 십 년 동안 못 만나서 루디는 다시 만나면 어색할까 봐 걱정했어요.

w|canggung.text: Suasana rapat jadi canggung setelah dua programmer berdebat soal desain.
w|canggung.en: The meeting became awkward after two programmers argued about the design.
w|canggung.ko: 프로그래머 두 명이 디자인을 두고 다툰 뒤 회의 분위기가 어색해졌어요.

w|cangkir.text: Pelanggan tetap Fajar selalu memesan secangkir kopi hitam bersama roti bakar.
w|cangkir.en: Fajar's regular customer always orders a cup of black coffee with toast.
w|cangkir.ko: 파자르의 단골손님은 늘 토스트와 함께 블랙커피 한 잔을 시켜요.

w|cangkir.text: Setelah mandi, Lestari minum secangkir teh jahe hangat.
w|cangkir.en: After showering, Lestari drank a cup of warm ginger tea.
w|cangkir.ko: 샤워하고 나서 레스타리는 따뜻한 생강차 한 잔을 마셨어요.

w|capek.text: Agus sudah capek menahan sakit gigi selama seminggu.
w|capek.en: Agus is tired of putting up with toothache for a week.
w|capek.ko: 아구스는 일주일 동안 치통을 참느라 지쳤어요.

w|capek.text: Wati sudah capek, tapi masih ingin menyelesaikan pintu dapur hari ini.
w|capek.en: Wati is tired, but she still wants to finish the kitchen door today.
w|capek.ko: 와티는 지쳤지만 오늘 부엌문까지는 끝내고 싶어요.

w|catur.text: Saat sidang diskors, Fajar bermain catur di ponselnya.
w|catur.en: While the hearing was adjourned, Fajar played chess on his phone.
w|catur.ko: 재판이 잠시 휴정하는 동안 파자르는 휴대폰으로 체스를 뒀어요.

w|catur.text: Bapak-bapak bermain catur di bangku depan warung Lestari.
w|catur.en: The men play chess on the bench in front of Lestari's shop.
w|catur.ko: 아저씨들이 레스타리 가게 앞 벤치에서 체스를 둬요.

w|cedera.text: Gigi depan Agus patah karena cedera saat bermain futsal.
w|cedera.en: Agus's front tooth broke from an injury while playing futsal.
w|cedera.ko: 아구스의 앞니는 풋살을 하다 다쳐서 부러졌어요.

w|cedera.text: Tukang itu memakai sarung tangan tebal untuk mencegah cedera saat memotong kaca.
w|cedera.en: The builder wore thick gloves to prevent injury while cutting glass.
w|cedera.ko: 그 인부는 유리를 자를 때 다치지 않으려고 두꺼운 장갑을 꼈어요.

w|cek.text: Cek lagi semua dokumen sebelum dikirim.
w|cek.en: Check all the documents again before sending.

w|cek.text: Dokter akan cek tekanan darahmu sebentar.
w|cek.en: The doctor will check your blood pressure shortly.
w|cek.ko: 의사가 곧 혈압을 재 볼 거야.

w|celah.text: Sinar matahari masuk lewat celah atap dan menyinari arca batu.

w|direktur.text: Dia baru saja diangkat menjadi direktur.

w|disiplin.text: Pelatih pramuka sangat menekankan disiplin waktu.
w|disiplin.en: The scout leader puts a strong emphasis on punctuality.
w|disiplin.ko: 스카우트 지도자는 시간 규율을 아주 강조해요.

w|disiplin.text: Siti berterima kasih kepada guru yang dulu mengajarinya disiplin belajar.
w|disiplin.en: Siti thanked the teacher who once taught her study discipline.
w|disiplin.ko: 시티는 예전에 공부하는 습관을 길러 준 선생님께 감사 인사를 했어요.

w|disitu.en: There is an empty seat over there.

w|disitu.text: Kami menunggu disitu sampai hujan reda.
w|disitu.en: We waited over there until the rain stopped.
w|disitu.ko: 비가 그칠 때까지 우리는 저기서 기다렸어.

w|distrik.text: Pengadilan distrik itu menangani ratusan perkara setiap tahun.
w|distrik.en: That district court handles hundreds of cases every year.
w|distrik.ko: 그 지방 법원은 해마다 수백 건의 사건을 처리해요.

w|distrik.text: Pemasok dari distrik sebelah datang mengantar telur dua kali seminggu.
w|distrik.en: A supplier from the next district comes to deliver eggs twice a week.
w|distrik.ko: 옆 지역 납품업자가 일주일에 두 번 달걀을 배달하러 와요.

w|ditakdirkan.text: Kisah itu seolah ditakdirkan berakhir bahagia.
w|ditakdirkan.en: That story seems destined to end happily.
w|ditakdirkan.ko: 그 이야기는 행복하게 끝나도록 운명인 듯해.

w|diundang.text: Kami diundang ke pernikahan teman lama.
w|diundang.en: We were invited to an old friend's wedding.

w|diundang.text: Dia diundang berbicara di konferensi itu.
w|diundang.en: He was invited to speak at that conference.

w|divisi.en: The sales division hit the monthly target.

w|divisi.text: Dia pindah ke divisi baru minggu ini.
w|divisi.en: She moved to a new division this week.
w|divisi.ko: 그녀는 이번 주에 새 부서로 옮겼어.

w|doa.text: Ibunya mengirim doa sebelum dia berangkat.
w|doa.en: His mother sent a prayer before he left.
w|doa.ko: 어머니가 그가 떠나기 전에 기도를 보냈어.

w|doa.en: That short prayer calmed her heart.
w|doa.ko: 그 짧은 기도가 마음을 가라앉혀 주었어.

w|dokter.en: I have to see a doctor.

w|dokumen.text: Dokumen itu hilang di meja kerja.
w|dokumen.en: That document went missing on the desk.

w|dokumen.text: Tolong simpan dokumen di folder aman.
w|dokumen.en: Please keep the document in a safe folder.
w|dokumen.ko: 그 문서를 안전한 폴더에 보관해 줘.

w|dolar.en: The price is a hundred dollars.

w|domba.text: Domba itu makan rumput di padang.
w|domba.en: That sheep is eating grass in the field.
w|domba.ko: 그 양이 들판에서 풀을 먹고 있어.

w|domba.en: The farmer cares for a flock of sheep.

w|dompet.text: Dia lupa membawa dompet ke kantor.
w|dompet.en: He forgot to bring his wallet to the office.
w|dompet.ko: 그는 지갑을 사무실에 가져가는 걸 잊었어.

w|dompet.text: Dompet hitam itu jatuh di bawah kursi.
w|dompet.en: That black wallet fell under the chair.
w|dompet.ko: 그 검은 지갑이 의자 아래로 떨어졌어.

w|dong.text: Ceritakan saja dong apa yang terjadi.
w|dong.en: Just tell me what happened, okay?

w|dongeng.en: Grandma reads a fairy tale before bedtime.
w|dongeng.ko: 할머니가 자기 전에 동화를 읽어 줘.

w|dongeng.text: Dongeng itu mengajarkan kejujuran kepada anak.
w|dongeng.en: That fairy tale teaches honesty to children.

w|dorongan.text: Berkat dorongan redakturnya, Eko berani menulis kolom opini pertamanya.
w|dorongan.en: Thanks to his editor's encouragement, Eko dared to write his first opinion column.
w|dorongan.ko: 편집장의 격려 덕분에 에코는 첫 칼럼을 쓸 용기를 냈어요.

w|dorongan.text: Ayu membuka toko sendiri berkat dorongan ayahnya.
w|dorongan.en: Ayu opened her own shop thanks to her father's encouragement.
w|dorongan.ko: 아유는 아버지의 응원 덕분에 자기 가게를 열었어요.

w|dosa.en: He feels he carries a great sin.
w|dosa.ko: 그는 큰 죄를 지고 있다고 느껴.

w|dosis.text: Dimas menghitung dosis obat berdasarkan berat badan kelinci itu.
w|dosis.en: Dimas calculated the dose of medicine based on the rabbit's weight.
w|dosis.ko: 디마스는 토끼 몸무게에 맞춰 약 용량을 계산했어요.

w|dosis.text: Tim Putri mencoba dosis yang lebih rendah pada percobaan berikutnya.
w|dosis.en: Putri's team tried a lower dose in the next experiment.
w|dosis.ko: 푸트리 팀은 다음 실험에서 더 낮은 용량을 시도했어요.

w|drama.en: They watched a Korean drama together.

w|dramatis.text: Adegan terakhir sangat dramatis sampai banyak penonton menangis.
w|dramatis.en: The final scene was so dramatic that many in the audience cried.
w|dramatis.ko: 마지막 장면이 너무 극적이어서 많은 관객이 울었어요.

w|dramatis.text: Penjualan kuartal ini naik secara dramatis berkat ide Intan.
w|dramatis.en: Sales this quarter rose dramatically thanks to Intan's idea.
w|dramatis.ko: 인탄의 아이디어 덕분에 이번 분기 매출이 크게 뛰었어요.

w|drum.text: Andi menabuh drum di band sekolah saat pentas seni.
w|drum.en: Andi plays the drums in the school band at the arts show.
w|drum.ko: 안디는 예술제에서 학교 밴드의 드럼을 쳐요.

w|drum.text: Suara drum dari pawai di luar terdengar sampai ke bangsal.
w|drum.en: The sound of drums from the parade outside could be heard all the way to the ward.
w|drum.ko: 밖에서 열린 행진의 북소리가 병동까지 들렸어요.

w|dugaan.en: The police's initial suspicion turned out wrong.

w|dugaan.text: Menurut dugaan saya, dia akan terlambat.
w|dugaan.en: According to my guess, he will be late.

w|dukungan.ko: 가족의 지원이 그를 더 강하게 만들었어.

w|dukungan.text: Kami memberi dukungan penuh kepada tim.
w|dukungan.en: We give full support to the team.

w|duluan.text: Kamu duluan saja; aku menyusul nanti.
w|duluan.en: You go first; I'll follow later.
w|duluan.ko: 너 먼저 가; 나는 나중에 따라갈게.

w|duluan.text: Duluan dia sudah sampai di sana.

w|duta.text: Sekolah Eko dikunjungi seorang duta besar yang bercerita tentang pekerjaannya.
w|duta.en: Eko's school was visited by an ambassador who talked about his work.
w|duta.ko: 에코네 학교에 대사 한 분이 와서 자기 일에 대해 이야기했어요.

w|duta.text: Waktu libur, Ayu menonton berita tentang duta lingkungan dari kampusnya.
w|duta.en: During the holiday, Ayu watched a news report about an environmental ambassador from her campus.
w|duta.ko: 방학 동안 아유는 자기 대학 출신 환경 홍보대사에 관한 뉴스를 봤어요.

w|efek.text: Obat itu punya efek samping ringan.
w|efek.en: That medicine has a mild side effect.

w|efek.text: Efek cahaya membuat foto lebih dramatis.
w|efek.en: The lighting effect makes the photo more dramatic.
w|efek.ko: 빛 효과가 사진을 더 극적으로 만들어.

w|efektif.text: Patroli malam terbukti efektif mengurangi pencurian di kampung Andi.
w|efektif.en: Night patrols have proven effective at reducing theft in Andi's neighborhood.
w|efektif.ko: 야간 순찰은 안디네 동네 도난을 줄이는 데 효과가 있었어요.

w|efektif.text: Pertahanan zona ternyata efektif menahan pemain tinggi lawan.
w|efektif.en: The zone defense turned out to be effective at stopping the opponent's tall players.
w|efektif.ko: 지역 방어가 상대 장신 선수를 막는 데 효과적이었어요.

w|egois.text: Egois sekali kalau hanya memikirkan diri sendiri.
w|egois.en: It is so selfish to only think of yourself.

w|ekonomi.text: Ekonomi negara itu tumbuh stabil tahun ini.
w|ekonomi.en: That country's economy grew steadily this year.
w|ekonomi.ko: 그 나라 경제는 올해 안정적으로 성장했어.

w|ekonomi.text: Dia kuliah jurusan ekonomi di universitas.
w|ekonomi.en: She majors in economics at the university.

w|ekor.text: Kucing itu mengibas ekor dengan cepat.
w|ekor.en: That cat flicked its tail quickly.

w|ekor.text: Ekor ikan itu berwarna oranye cerah.
w|ekor.en: That fish's tail is bright orange.

w|eksperimen.text: Ahli forensik menjelaskan hasil eksperimen yang dilakukan di laboratorium.
w|eksperimen.en: The forensic expert explained the results of the experiment carried out in the lab.
w|eksperimen.ko: 법의학 전문가가 실험실에서 한 실험 결과를 설명했어요.

w|eksperimen.text: Anak Lestari membeli cuka dan soda kue untuk eksperimen di sekolah.
w|eksperimen.en: Lestari's child bought vinegar and baking soda for an experiment at school.
w|eksperimen.ko: 레스타리의 아이는 학교 실험에 쓸 식초와 베이킹소다를 샀어요.

w|ekspresi.text: Sutradara meminta Bayu memperbaiki ekspresi wajahnya di adegan sedih.
w|ekspresi.en: The director asked Bayu to work on his facial expression in the sad scene.
w|ekspresi.ko: 연출가는 바유에게 슬픈 장면에서 표정을 고치라고 했어요.

w|ekspresi.text: Dari ekspresi bosnya, Intan tahu rapat itu tidak berjalan lancar.
w|ekspresi.en: From her boss's expression, Intan knew the meeting hadn't gone well.
w|ekspresi.ko: 인탄은 상사의 표정을 보고 회의가 잘 안 풀렸다는 걸 알았어요.

w|ekstra.text: Menjelang tahun baru, polisi menambah penjagaan ekstra di jalan utama.
w|ekstra.en: Ahead of New Year, the police add extra guards on the main road.
w|ekstra.ko: 새해를 앞두고 경찰은 큰길에 경비를 더 세워요.

w|ekstra.text: Menjelang final, Dewi berlatih ekstra pada malam hari.
w|ekstra.en: Ahead of the final, Dewi does extra practice at night.
w|ekstra.ko: 결승을 앞두고 데위는 밤에 추가 훈련을 해요.

w|elang.text: Seekor elang terbang rendah mencari anak ayam di halaman Dimas.
w|elang.en: An eagle flew low looking for chicks in Dimas's yard.
w|elang.ko: 독수리 한 마리가 디마스네 마당에서 병아리를 찾으며 낮게 날았어요.

w|elang.text: Saat istirahat, Putri menonton video elang menangkap ikan.
w|elang.en: During her break, Putri watched a video of an eagle catching fish.
w|elang.ko: 쉬는 시간에 푸트리는 독수리가 물고기를 잡는 영상을 봤어요.

w|elektronik.text: Musik pengiring drama itu dimainkan dengan alat musik elektronik.
w|elektronik.en: The play's accompanying music was performed on electronic instruments.
w|elektronik.ko: 그 연극의 반주는 전자 악기로 연주됐어요.

w|elektronik.text: Kantor Intan sekarang memakai tanda tangan elektronik untuk semua kontrak.
w|elektronik.en: Intan's office now uses electronic signatures for all contracts.
w|elektronik.ko: 인탄의 회사는 이제 모든 계약에 전자 서명을 써요.

w|elemen.text: Dimas mencari buku kimia tentang tabel elemen untuk tugas sekolah.
w|elemen.en: Dimas looked for a chemistry book about the table of elements for a school assignment.
w|elemen.ko: 디마스는 학교 숙제로 원소 주기율표에 관한 화학책을 찾았어요.

w|elemen.text: Lampu kereta mati karena salah satu elemen pemanas di gerbong terbakar.
w|elemen.en: The train lights went out because one of the heating elements in the carriage burned out.

w|email.text: Saya mengirim email konfirmasi tadi pagi.
w|email.en: I sent a confirmation email this morning.
w|email.ko: 나는 오늘 아침 확인 이메일을 보냈어.

w|email.text: Email penting itu masuk ke folder spam.
w|email.en: That important email went into the spam folder.
w|email.ko: 그 중요한 이메일이 스팸 폴더로 들어갔어.

w|emas.en: That ring is made of gold.
The price of gold went up again.

w|emosi.en: He finds it hard to control his emotions.
Strong emotion showed on her face.

w|emosional.text: Pidato itu sangat emosional bagi para hadirin.
w|emosional.en: That speech was very emotional for the audience.

w|emosional.text: Dia menjadi emosional saat membaca surat itu.
w|emosional.en: She became emotional while reading that letter.
w|emosional.ko: 그는 그 편지를 읽으며 감정적이 됐어.

w|enam.text: Ada enam kursi di ruangan itu.

w|enam.ko: 그 방에는 의자 여섯 개가 있어.

w|enam.text: Enam orang sudah menunggu di luar.

w|energi.text: Dia kehabisan energi setelah berlari jauh.
w|energi.en: He ran out of energy after running far.
w|energi.ko: 멀리 달린 뒤 그는 기운이 다 빠졌어.

w|engkau.text: Aku percaya engkau bisa menyelesaikan ini.
w|engkau.en: I believe you can finish this.
w|engkau.ko: 난 네가 이걸 해낼 수 있다고 믿어.

w|entah.en: I don't know why I'm sad.

w|enyah.text: Enyah dari sini sebelum masalah bertambah.
w|enyah.en: Get out of here before the problem grows.

w|enyah.text: Dia menyuruh burung itu enyah dari jendela.
w|enyah.en: She told the bird to go away from the window.
w|enyah.ko: 그는 새에게 창에서 저리 가라고 했어.

w|episode.text: Episode baru akan tayang malam ini.
w|episode.en: A new episode will air tonight.
I've already watched the last episode.

w|era.text: Kakek Budi bilang di era mudanya musim hujan datang lebih tepat waktu.
w|era.en: Budi's grandfather says that in his youth the rainy season came more on time.
w|era.ko: 부디의 할아버지는 젊었을 때는 우기가 더 제때 왔다고 해요.

w|era.text: Film itu bercerita tentang keluarga di era tahun tujuh puluhan.
w|era.en: The film tells the story of a family in the seventies era.
w|era.ko: 그 영화는 칠십 년대 시대의 한 가족 이야기를 담고 있어요.

w|erat.text: Dimas memegang erat buku langka itu supaya tidak jatuh.
w|erat.en: Dimas held the rare book tightly so it wouldn't fall.
w|erat.ko: 디마스는 그 희귀본이 떨어지지 않게 꼭 붙잡았어요.

w|erat.text: Putri memeluk erat ibunya sebelum naik ke gerbong.
w|erat.en: Putri hugged her mother tightly before boarding the carriage.
w|erat.ko: 푸트리는 기차에 오르기 전에 엄마를 꼭 안았어요.

w|eropa.text: Eropa menarik banyak wisatawan setiap musim.
w|eropa.en: Europe attracts many tourists every season.

w|eropa.text: Dia belajar sejarah eropa di kampus.
w|eropa.en: She studies European history on campus.

w|es.en: The ice on the road has melted.

w|esok.en: According to the forecast, tomorrow morning will be foggy in Budi's area.
w|esok.ko: 일기 예보에 따르면 내일 아침 부디네 지역에 안개가 낀대요.

w|esok.text: Sutradara bilang adegan di pasar akan diambil esok hari.

w|esok.ko: 감독은 시장 장면을 내일 찍을 거라고 했어요.

w|evakuasi.text: Polisi memimpin evakuasi warga ketika sungai di dekat kantor meluap.
w|evakuasi.en: The police led the evacuation of residents when the river near the station overflowed.
w|evakuasi.ko: 경찰서 근처 강이 넘쳤을 때 경찰이 주민 대피를 이끌었어요.

w|evakuasi.text: Pertandingan dihentikan dan penonton menjalani evakuasi karena alarm kebakaran berbunyi.
w|evakuasi.en: The match was stopped and spectators were evacuated because the fire alarm went off.
w|evakuasi.ko: 화재경보가 울려서 경기가 중단되고 관중이 대피했어요.

w|fajar.text: Fajar merah mewarnai langit pagi itu.
w|fajar.en: A red dawn colored the morning sky.
w|fajar.ko: 붉은 새벽이 그날 아침 하늘을 물들였어.

w|fakta.text: Itu fakta yang tidak bisa dibantah.
w|fakta.en: That's a fact that can't be denied.

w|fantasi.text: Cerpen Budi penuh fantasi tentang naga dan kerajaan di bawah laut.
w|fantasi.en: Budi's short story is full of fantasy about dragons and an undersea kingdom.
w|fantasi.ko: 부디의 단편 소설은 용과 바닷속 왕국에 관한 판타지로 가득해요.

w|fantasi.text: Siti bilang cita-citanya dulu menjadi astronaut hanyalah fantasi anak kecil.
w|fantasi.en: Siti said her old dream of becoming an astronaut was just a child's fantasy.

w|fantastis.en: The view from the summit is fantastic.
Their performance last night was fantastic.

w|fasilitas.en: This hotel's facilities are very complete.
w|fasilitas.ko: 이 호텔 시설이 아주 잘 갖춰져 있어.

w|fasilitas.en: The school added new sports facilities.

w|favorit.text: Restoran favorit kami tutup hari ini.
w|favorit.en: Our favorite restaurant is closed today.

w|festival.text: Festival musik itu menarik banyak pengunjung.
w|festival.en: That music festival attracts many visitors.
w|festival.ko: 그 음악 축제는 많은 방문객을 끌어들여.

w|festival.text: Kami menonton festival lampion di malam hari.
w|festival.en: We watched the lantern festival at night.

w|film.en: Want to watch a movie tonight?

w|final.text: Tim kami lolos ke babak final.
w|final.en: Our team advanced to the final round.
The match final was broadcast live.

w|firasat.text: Dalam suratnya, Rudi menulis bahwa dia punya firasat buruk sebelum pindah kota.
w|firasat.en: In his letter, Rudi wrote that he had a bad feeling before moving to another city.
w|firasat.ko: 루디는 편지에 다른 도시로 이사하기 전에 불길한 예감이 들었다고 썼어요.

w|firasat.en: Rina has a hunch that their new app will be popular among university students.
w|firasat.ko: 리나는 새 앱이 대학생들 사이에서 잘될 거라는 예감이 들어요.

w|fisik.en: That athlete's physique is very strong.

w|fisika.text: Ilmu fisika yang Bayu pelajari di kampus ternyata berguna untuk merawat mesin.
w|fisika.en: The physics Bayu studied at university turned out to be useful for maintaining machines.

w|kebingungan.en: Lestari saw the confusion on the face of a tourist looking for mineral water.

w|kebocoran.ko: 객차 지붕에서 물이 새서 승객들이 불평했어요.

w|kebodohan.en: The teacher told about the foolishness of her youth when she once put salt in a cake.
w|kebodohan.ko: 선생님은 젊을 때 케이크에 소금을 넣었던 어리석은 실수를 이야기했어요.

w|kebun.en: Grandma waters the garden every afternoon.

Clean water is an important need.

w|kecanduan.ko: 와티는 낡은 집 고치는 게 끊기 힘든 중독 같다며 농담해요.

w|kecantikan.text: Produk kecantikan itu laris di toko.
w|kecantikan.en: That beauty product sells well at the store.
w|kecantikan.ko: 그 미용 제품은 가게에서 잘 팔려.

w|kecelakaan.en: There's an accident on the road.

w|kecepatan.en: Reduce your speed at the bend.
That car's speed is too high.

w|kecerdasan.ko: 바유의 새 연극은 인공지능 로봇에 관한 이야기예요.

w|kecewa.en: He is disappointed with the result.
Don't be disappointed if you fail once.

w|kecuali.text: Boleh makan apa saja kecuali itu.
w|kecuali.en: You can eat anything except that.

w|kedai.text: Sebelum punya toko sendiri, Fajar bekerja di kedai kopi di pinggir jalan.
w|kedai.en: Before having his own shop, Fajar worked at a roadside coffee stall.
w|kedai.ko: 자기 가게를 차리기 전에 파자르는 길가 커피 가게에서 일했어요.

w|kedai.text: Setelah finis, Lestari dan teman-temannya mampir ke kedai bubur.
w|kedai.en: After finishing, Lestari and her friends stopped by a porridge stall.
w|kedai.ko: 결승선을 통과한 뒤 레스타리와 친구들은 죽 가게에 들렀어요.

w|kedalaman.text: Malam itu Budi baru sadar kedalaman rasa kecewa adiknya.
w|kedalaman.en: That night Budi finally realized how deep his sister's disappointment was.
w|kedalaman.ko: 그날 밤에야 부디는 동생이 얼마나 깊이 실망했는지 깨달았어요.

w|kedalaman.text: Siti bertanya kepada tukang tentang kedalaman sumur di belakang rumah.
w|kedalaman.en: Siti asked the handyman about the depth of the well behind the house.
w|kedalaman.ko: 시티는 일꾼에게 집 뒤 우물의 깊이를 물어봤어요.

w|kedamaian.text: Kedamaian di desa itu sangat menenangkan.
w|kedamaian.en: The peace in that village is very soothing.

w|kediaman.en: Bayu just moved into his new residence on the ninth floor.
w|kediaman.ko: 바유는 구 층에 있는 새 거처로 막 이사했어요.

w|kediaman.en: Intan took the night train to go back to her parents' residence in Surabaya.
w|kediaman.ko: 인탄은 수라바야에 있는 부모님 댁에 가려고 야간열차를 탔어요.

w|kedinginan.text: Anak itu kedinginan di luar rumah.
w|kedinginan.en: The child was freezing outside the house.
w|kedinginan.ko: 그 아이는 집 밖에서 추위에 떨었어.

w|kedinginan.en: The cold made his hands tremble.

w|kedokteran.ko: 리나는 의대에 다니고 있어서 그 돈은 책을 사려던 거였어요.

w|kedokteran.text: Tetangga sebelah Siti ternyata dosen fakultas kedokteran.

w|kedokteran.ko: 시티의 옆집 이웃은 알고 보니 의대 교수예요.

w|kedua.en: The second child has been born.

w|kedutaan.text: Pameran tekstil kali ini didukung oleh beberapa kedutaan asing.
w|kedutaan.en: This textile exhibition is supported by several foreign embassies.

w|kedutaan.text: Seorang pegawai kedutaan rutin membeli rempah-rempah dari Rina.

w|kedutaan.ko: 한 대사관 직원이 리나에게서 꾸준히 향신료를 사요.

w|keempat.text: Dia finis di posisi keempat dalam balapan.
w|keempat.en: He finished in fourth place in the race.

w|keempat.text: Bab keempat novel itu sangat menegangkan.

w|kegagalan.en: That failure taught him many lessons.

w|kegagalan.text: Dia tidak takut menghadapi kegagalan lagi.
w|kegagalan.en: She is not afraid to face failure again.
w|kegagalan.ko: 그녀는 다시 실패를 마주하는 걸 두려워하지 않아.

w|kegelapan.en: She is afraid of the dark.

w|kegiatan.text: Kegiatan sekolah dimulai setelah libur panjang.
