w|mempercepat.text: Hotel memasang mesin baru untuk mempercepat proses check-in.
w|mempercepat.en: The hotel installed a new machine to speed up check-in.
w|mempercepat.ko: 호텔은 체크인을 빠르게 하려고 새 기계를 들여놓았어요.

w|memperhatikan.en: Please pay attention to the road.
The teacher told us to pay attention.

w|memperingatkan.text: Guru memperingatkan siswa tentang bahaya api.
w|memperingatkan.en: The teacher warned students about fire danger.
Warning a friend is a form of care.

w|memperjelas.text: Eko meminta nelayan memperjelas jam berangkat perahu besok pagi.
w|memperjelas.en: Eko asked the fisherman to make clear what time the boat leaves tomorrow morning.
w|memperjelas.ko: 에코는 어부에게 내일 아침 배가 몇 시에 떠나는지 분명히 말해 달라고 했어요.

w|memperjelas.text: Ayu menulis pesan di grup warga untuk memperjelas jadwal ronda.
w|memperjelas.en: Ayu wrote a message in the residents' group to clarify the night-watch schedule.
w|memperjelas.ko: 아유는 야간 순찰 일정을 분명히 하려고 주민 단체방에 글을 남겼어요.

w|memperjuangkan.text: Dimas ikut memperjuangkan aturan yang melarang penelantaran hewan peliharaan.
w|memperjuangkan.en: Dimas joined the fight for a rule banning the abandonment of pets.
w|memperjuangkan.ko: 디마스는 반려동물 유기를 금지하는 규정을 위해 함께 힘썼어요.

w|memperjuangkan.text: Putri terus memperjuangkan dana tambahan untuk proyek vaksin timnya.
w|memperjuangkan.en: Putri keeps fighting for extra funding for her team's vaccine project.
w|memperjuangkan.ko: 푸트리는 팀의 백신 사업을 위해 추가 예산을 얻으려고 계속 애쓰고 있어요.

w|memperkenalkan.text: Guru memperkenalkan siswa baru ke kelas.
w|memperkenalkan.en: The teacher introduced the new student to the class.
She wants to introduce the newest product.
w|memperkenalkan.ko: 그는 최신 제품을 소개하고 싶어 해.

w|memperkirakan.text: Manajer memperkirakan pesanan akan naik menjelang Lebaran.
w|memperkirakan.en: The manager estimates orders will rise ahead of Eid.
w|memperkirakan.ko: 관리자는 르바란을 앞두고 주문이 늘 거라고 예상해요.

w|memperkirakan.text: Pilot memperkirakan pesawat akan mendarat dua puluh menit lebih awal.
w|memperkirakan.en: The pilot estimated the plane would land twenty minutes early.
w|memperkirakan.ko: 기장은 비행기가 이십 분 일찍 착륙할 거라고 예상했어요.

w|memperlakukan.text: Guru itu memperlakukan semua siswa dengan adil.
w|memperlakukan.en: That teacher treats all students fairly.
w|memperlakukan.ko: 그 선생님은 모든 학생을 공정하게 대해.

w|memperlambat.text: Obat kumur itu bisa memperlambat pertumbuhan karang gigi.
w|memperlambat.en: That mouthwash can slow down the build-up of tartar.
w|memperlambat.ko: 그 구강 청결제는 치석이 생기는 걸 늦출 수 있어요.

w|memperlambat.text: Hujan berhari-hari memperlambat pekerjaan memasang atap baru.
w|memperlambat.en: Days of rain slowed down the work on the new roof.
w|memperlambat.ko: 며칠 동안 내린 비 때문에 새 지붕 공사가 더뎌졌어요.

w|memperlihatkan.text: Budi memperlihatkan hasil gambarnya kepada wali kelas.
w|memperlihatkan.en: Budi showed his drawing to his homeroom teacher.
w|memperlihatkan.ko: 부디는 자기 그림을 담임 선생님께 보여 드렸어요.

w|memperlihatkan.text: Pemilik rumah memperlihatkan letak meteran listrik kepada Siti.
w|memperlihatkan.en: The landlord showed Siti where the electricity meter is.
w|memperlihatkan.ko: 집주인이 시티에게 전기 계량기 위치를 보여 줬어요.

w|mempermainkan.en: Don't toy with other people's feelings.
They played with the rules just to win.

w|mempermalukan.text: Hakim mengingatkan pengacara agar tidak mempermalukan saksi di depan umum.
w|mempermalukan.en: The judge reminded the lawyer not to humiliate the witness in public.
w|mempermalukan.ko: 판사는 변호사에게 증인을 공개적으로 망신 주지 말라고 주의를 줬어요.

w|mempermalukan.text: Lestari tidak mau mempermalukan pelanggan yang lupa membawa dompet.
w|mempermalukan.en: Lestari doesn't want to embarrass customers who forget their wallets.
w|mempermalukan.ko: 레스타리는 지갑을 깜빡한 손님을 창피하게 만들고 싶지 않아요.

w|memperoleh.en: She managed to obtain a full scholarship.
w|memperoleh.ko: 그녀는 전액 장학금을 얻는 데 성공했어.

w|memperoleh.en: Our team obtained a narrow victory.

w|mempersembahkan.text: Saat pesta panen, para penari mempersembahkan tarian untuk Dewi Sri.
w|mempersembahkan.en: At the harvest festival, the dancers performed a dance in honor of Dewi Sri.
w|mempersembahkan.ko: 추수 잔치 때 무용수들은 데위 스리에게 춤을 바쳤어요.

w|mempersembahkan.text: Siti mempersembahkan perannya di film ini untuk almarhum ayahnya.
w|mempersembahkan.en: Siti dedicated her role in this film to her late father.
w|mempersembahkan.ko: 시티는 이 영화의 배역을 돌아가신 아버지께 바쳤어요.

w|mempersiapkan.en: They prepared the documents for the meeting.

w|mempertahankan.en: The team tries to maintain the score lead.
Preserving family tradition matters to him.
w|mempertahankan.ko: 가족 전통을 지키는 게 그에게 중요해.

w|mempertanyakan.text: Pengawas mempertanyakan kualitas pasir yang dikirim kemarin.
w|mempertanyakan.en: The supervisor questioned the quality of the sand delivered yesterday.
w|mempertanyakan.ko: 감독관은 어제 들어온 모래의 품질을 문제 삼았어요.

w|mempertanyakan.text: Rina mulai mempertanyakan keputusannya pindah kerja saat melihat tumpukan tugas.
w|mempertanyakan.en: Rina began to question her decision to change jobs when she saw the pile of tasks.
w|mempertanyakan.ko: 리나는 쌓인 업무를 보고 이직한 결정을 되묻기 시작했어요.

w|mempertaruhkan.en: He risked his career for honesty.
Risking one's life is not a wise choice.
w|mempertaruhkan.ko: 목숨을 거는 건 현명한 선택이 아니야.

w|mempertimbangkan.text: Kami mempertimbangkan semua usulan dengan saksama.

w|mempertimbangkan.en: Considering the risks is very important.
w|mempertimbangkan.ko: 위험을 따져 보는 건 아주 중요해.

w|mempesona.text: Senyum Agus terlihat mempesona setelah giginya diputihkan.
w|mempesona.en: Agus's smile looked dazzling after his teeth were whitened.
w|mempesona.ko: 미백을 하고 나니 아구스의 미소가 눈부셨어요.

w|mempesona.text: Lantai ubin motif lama di ruang tengah terlihat mempesona setelah dicuci.
w|mempesona.en: The old patterned floor tiles in the main room looked stunning after being washed.
w|mempesona.ko: 가운데 방의 옛 무늬 타일 바닥은 닦고 나니 눈부시게 예뻤어요.

w|memprediksi.text: Rudi bercanda bahwa dulu Bayu bisa memprediksi nilai ujian semua teman sekelas.
w|memprediksi.en: Rudi joked that Bayu used to be able to predict the exam scores of the whole class.
w|memprediksi.ko: 루디는 바유가 예전에 반 친구들 시험 점수를 다 맞히곤 했다고 농담했어요.

w|memprediksi.text: Rina memakai data tahun lalu untuk memprediksi jumlah pengguna bulan depan.
w|memprediksi.en: Rina used last year's data to predict next month's number of users.
w|memprediksi.ko: 리나는 작년 자료로 다음 달 사용자 수를 예측했어요.

w|memproduksi.text: Setiap hari pabrik itu memproduksi ribuan potong kemeja.
w|memproduksi.en: Every day the factory produces thousands of shirts.
w|memproduksi.ko: 그 공장은 날마다 셔츠 수천 벌을 생산해요.

w|memproduksi.text: Perusahaan Intan memproduksi makanan ringan yang dijual di bandara.
w|memproduksi.en: Intan's company produces snacks that are sold at the airport.
w|memproduksi.ko: 인탄의 회사는 공항에서 파는 과자를 생산해요.

w|memuaskan.text: Sutradara bilang hasil gladi resik kemarin cukup memuaskan.
w|memuaskan.en: The director said yesterday's dress rehearsal was quite satisfying.
w|memuaskan.ko: 연출가는 어제 리허설 결과가 꽤 만족스러웠다고 했어요.

w|memuaskan.text: Manajer bilang laporan bulanan Intan sangat memuaskan.
w|memuaskan.en: The manager said Intan's monthly report was very satisfying.
w|memuaskan.ko: 매니저는 인탄의 월간 보고서가 아주 만족스럽다고 했어요.

w|memuat.text: Para buruh memuat karung kain ke atas truk sejak pagi.
w|memuat.en: The workers have been loading sacks of cloth onto the truck since morning.
w|memuat.ko: 노동자들은 아침부터 천 자루를 트럭에 싣고 있어요.

w|memuat.text: Petugas bandara memuat koper-koper ke bagasi pesawat.
w|memuat.en: Airport staff loaded the suitcases into the plane's hold.
w|memuat.ko: 공항 직원들이 여행 가방을 비행기 화물칸에 실었어요.

w|memudar.en: Little by little, Rina's annoyance faded.

w|memudar.text: Cat dinding kamar mulai memudar, jadi Siti berencana mengecat ulang.
w|memudar.en: The bedroom wall paint is starting to fade, so Siti plans to repaint.
w|memudar.ko: 방 벽 페인트가 바래기 시작해서 시티는 다시 칠할 계획이에요.

w|memuja.text: Remaja di lantai empat sangat memuja penyanyi pop dari Korea.
w|memuja.en: The teenager on the fourth floor adores a pop singer from Korea.
w|memuja.ko: 사 층의 십 대는 한국 팝 가수를 무척 좋아해요.

w|memuja.text: Intan duduk di dekat rombongan pemuda yang memuja band rock lokal.
w|memuja.en: Intan sat near a group of young men who idolize a local rock band.
w|memuja.ko: 인탄은 지역 록밴드를 숭배하는 청년 무리 근처에 앉았어요.

w|memuji.text: Guru kesenian memuji gambar Eko di depan seluruh kelas.
w|memuji.en: The art teacher praised Eko's drawing in front of the whole class.
w|memuji.ko: 미술 선생님이 반 전체 앞에서 에코의 그림을 칭찬했어요.

w|memuji.text: Semua orang memuji masakan ibu Ayu saat makan malam.
w|memuji.en: Everyone praised Ayu's mother's cooking at dinner.
w|memuji.ko: 저녁 식사 때 모두 아유 어머니의 요리를 칭찬했어요.

w|memukuli.text: Di kelas sejarah, Andi membaca kisah tentara kolonial yang memukuli para petani.
w|memukuli.en: In history class, Andi read about colonial soldiers beating the farmers.
w|memukuli.ko: 안디는 역사 시간에 식민지 군인들이 농민들을 때린 이야기를 읽었어요.

w|memukuli.text: Menurut berita, korban dirawat di sini setelah sekelompok orang memukuli dia di jalan.
w|memukuli.en: According to the news, the victim was treated here after a group of people beat him in the street.
w|memukuli.ko: 뉴스에 따르면 피해자는 길에서 여러 사람에게 맞은 뒤 이곳에서 치료를 받았어요.

w|memulai.en: Starting a new business needs capital.

w|memulihkan.text: Kelinci itu butuh dua minggu untuk memulihkan tenaga setelah operasi.
w|memulihkan.en: The rabbit needed two weeks to recover its strength after surgery.
w|memulihkan.ko: 토끼는 수술 뒤 기운을 되찾는 데 두 주가 걸렸어요.

w|memulihkan.text: Teknisi butuh sehari penuh untuk memulihkan data yang terhapus.
w|memulihkan.en: The technician needed a whole day to recover the deleted data.
w|memulihkan.ko: 기술자가 지워진 데이터를 복구하는 데 꼬박 하루가 걸렸어요.

w|memungkinkan.text: Teknologi memungkinkan kita belajar dari rumah.
w|memungkinkan.en: Technology allows us to study from home.
w|memungkinkan.ko: 기술이 집에서 공부할 수 있게 해 줘.

w|memungkinkan.en: Good weather makes a safe trip possible.
w|memungkinkan.ko: 좋은 날씨가 안전한 여행을 가능하게 해.

w|memusnahkan.text: Petugas pertanian memusnahkan tanaman yang terserang hama wereng.
w|memusnahkan.en: Agricultural officers destroyed plants that were attacked by planthoppers.
w|memusnahkan.ko: 농업 담당자들이 멸구 피해를 입은 작물을 없앴어요.

w|memusnahkan.text: Dalam cerita film itu, seorang raja jahat ingin memusnahkan seluruh desa.
w|memusnahkan.en: In the film's story, an evil king wants to wipe out the entire village.
w|memusnahkan.ko: 그 영화 이야기에서 악한 왕은 마을 전체를 없애려고 해요.

w|memutar.text: Dia memutar kunci di lubang pintu.
w|memutar.en: He turned the key in the door lock.
Please turn the radio volume a little.

w|menabrak.en: That car almost hit the fence.
w|menabrak.ko: 그 차가 거의 울타리를 들이받을 뻔했어.

w|menabrak.en: Don't bump into the table while walking.

w|menahan.en: Try holding your breath a moment.
He can barely hold back his anger.

w|menaiki.text: Penonton menaiki tangga sempit menuju balkon teater.
w|menaiki.en: The audience climbed the narrow stairs to the theatre balcony.
w|menaiki.ko: 관객들이 좁은 계단을 올라 극장 발코니로 갔어요.

w|menaiki.text: Intan menaiki lift ke lantai sepuluh sambil membawa kopi.
w|menaiki.en: Intan took the lift up to the tenth floor carrying her coffee.
w|menaiki.ko: 인탄은 커피를 들고 엘리베이터를 타고 십 층으로 올라갔어요.

w|menaikkan.text: Koran tempat Eko bekerja terpaksa menaikkan harga langganan bulan ini.
w|menaikkan.en: The newspaper where Eko works had to raise the subscription price this month.
w|menaikkan.ko: 에코가 일하는 신문사는 이번 달 구독료를 올릴 수밖에 없었어요.

w|menaikkan.text: Pemasok menaikkan harga layar sentuh, jadi ongkos servis ikut naik.
w|menaikkan.en: The supplier raised the price of touchscreens, so the service fee went up too.
w|menaikkan.ko: 공급업자가 터치스크린 값을 올려서 수리비도 같이 올랐어요.

w|menaklukkan.text: Hari itu Agus akhirnya berhasil menaklukkan rasa takutnya pada bor gigi.
w|menaklukkan.en: That day Agus finally managed to conquer his fear of the dental drill.
w|menaklukkan.ko: 그날 아구스는 마침내 치과 드릴에 대한 두려움을 이겨 냈어요.

w|menaklukkan.text: Wati akhirnya bisa menaklukkan pintu macet yang tidak terbuka selama bertahun-tahun.
w|menaklukkan.en: Wati finally managed to conquer the stuck door that hadn't opened for years.
w|menaklukkan.ko: 와티는 몇 년 동안 안 열리던 꽉 낀 문을 드디어 열어 냈어요.

w|menakuti.en: That sound frightened the little children.

w|menakuti.text: Menakuti hewan bukan permainan yang lucu.
w|menakuti.en: Scaring animals is not a funny game.
w|menakuti.ko: 동물을 겁주는 건 재미있는 놀이가 아니야.

w|menakutkan.en: The sounds at night are scary.

w|menamai.text: Waktu kecil, Budi yang menamai kucing mereka Si Belang.
w|menamai.en: When he was little, it was Budi who named their cat Si Belang.
w|menamai.ko: 어렸을 때 고양이에게 시블랑이라는 이름을 붙인 건 부디였어요.

w|menamai.text: Anak Siti menamai rumah baru mereka Istana Kecil.
w|menamai.en: Siti's child named their new house the Little Palace.
w|menamai.ko: 시티의 아이는 새집에 '작은 궁전'이라는 이름을 붙였어요.

w|menamakan.text: Anak tetangga menamakan kucing liar di parkiran itu Si Belang.
w|menamakan.en: The neighbor's child named the stray cat in the parking lot Spotty.
w|menamakan.ko: 이웃 아이는 주차장의 길고양이에게 얼룩이라는 이름을 붙였어요.

w|menamakan.text: Orang Belanda dulu menamakan stasiun itu dengan nama sebuah sungai.
w|menamakan.en: The Dutch once named that station after a river.
w|menamakan.ko: 예전에 네덜란드 사람들이 그 역에 강 이름을 붙였어요.

w|menambah.en: Please add just a little sugar.
Gaining more experience helps her career.
w|menambah.ko: 경험을 더하는 게 그녀의 경력에 도움이 돼.

w|menambahkan.text: Dia menambahkan gula ke dalam kopi.
w|menambahkan.en: She added sugar to the coffee.

w|menambahkan.text: Penulis menambahkan bab baru di novelnya.
w|menambahkan.en: The writer added a new chapter to his novel.

w|menampar.text: Di sinetron yang diputar di toko, seorang ibu menampar menantunya.
w|menampar.en: In the soap opera playing in the shop, a mother slapped her daughter-in-law.
w|menampar.ko: 가게에서 틀어 놓은 드라마에서 한 어머니가 며느리 뺨을 때렸어요.

w|menampar.text: Angin dingin pagi itu seperti menampar wajah para pelari.
w|menampar.en: The cold morning wind felt like it was slapping the runners' faces.
w|menampar.ko: 그날 아침 찬 바람이 달리기 선수들의 얼굴을 때리는 것 같았어요.

w|menampilkan.text: Koran daerah menampilkan foto Dimas dengan hasil panen semangka.
w|menampilkan.en: The local newspaper ran a photo of Dimas with his watermelon harvest.
w|menampilkan.ko: 지역 신문에 수박을 수확한 디마스의 사진이 실렸어요.

w|menampilkan.text: Poster di kamar Putri menampilkan tebing tinggi di tepi laut.
w|menampilkan.en: The poster in Putri's room shows a tall cliff by the sea.
w|menampilkan.ko: 푸트리 방의 포스터에는 바닷가의 높은 절벽이 담겨 있어요.

w|menanam.text: Musim ini Dimas mau menanam jagung di ladang sebelah rumah.
w|menanam.en: This season Dimas wants to plant corn in the field next to the house.
w|menanam.ko: 이번 철에 디마스는 집 옆 밭에 옥수수를 심으려고 해요.

w|menanam.text: Hari Minggu nanti, Putri ingin menanam cabai di pot.
w|menanam.en: This Sunday, Putri wants to plant chilies in pots.
w|menanam.ko: 이번 일요일에 푸트리는 화분에 고추를 심고 싶어 해요.

w|menandai.text: Eko menandai halaman penting di buku catatannya dengan stabilo kuning.
w|menandai.en: Eko marked the important pages in his notebook with a yellow highlighter.
w|menandai.ko: 에코는 공책의 중요한 쪽을 노란 형광펜으로 표시했어요.

w|menandai.text: Ayu menandai tanggal ulang tahun nenek di kalender dapur.
w|menandai.en: Ayu marked grandma's birthday on the kitchen calendar.
w|menandai.ko: 아유는 부엌 달력에 할머니 생신을 표시했어요.

w|menandatangani.text: Dia menandatangani kontrak di meja kayu.
w|menandatangani.en: She signed the contract on the wooden desk.

w|menandatangani.text: Menandatangani surat itu adalah langkah terakhir.
w|menandatangani.en: Signing that letter is the final step.
w|menandatangani.ko: 그 편지에 서명하는 게 마지막 단계야.

w|menghabisi.en: Rina set a trap to get rid of the rats damaging her rice sacks.
w|menghabisi.ko: 리나는 쌀자루를 망가뜨리는 쥐를 없애려고 덫을 놓았어요.

w|menghadap.text: Agus dipanggil untuk menghadap kepala dinas pukul sepuluh pagi.
w|menghadap.en: Agus was summoned to see the head of the department at ten in the morning.
w|menghadap.ko: 아구스는 오전 열 시에 국장 앞에 불려 갔어요.

w|menghadap.text: Saat bermain cello, Wati duduk menghadap jendela.
w|menghadap.en: When she plays the cello, Wati sits facing the window.
w|menghadap.ko: 첼로를 켤 때 와티는 창문을 바라보고 앉아요.

w|menghadapi.en: We have to face the problem.
She's afraid to face the truth.

w|menghadiri.text: Dia akan menghadiri upacara di balai kota.
w|menghadiri.en: She will attend the ceremony at city hall.

w|menghadiri.text: Banyak orang menghadiri konser malam itu.
w|menghadiri.en: Many people attended the concert that night.
w|menghadiri.ko: 그날 밤 많은 사람이 콘서트에 갔어.

w|menghajar.en: That thug tried to beat up the vendor.

w|menghajar.text: Menghajar lawan bukan cara yang baik.
w|menghajar.en: Beating up an opponent is not a good way.
w|menghajar.ko: 상대를 때리는 건 좋은 방법이 아니야.

w|menghakimi.text: Eko belajar untuk tidak menghakimi orang hanya dari penampilannya.
w|menghakimi.en: Eko learned not to judge people just by their appearance.
w|menghakimi.ko: 에코는 겉모습만 보고 사람을 판단하지 않는 법을 배웠어요.

w|menghakimi.text: Ayu tidak mau ikut menghakimi tetangga yang jarang keluar rumah.
w|menghakimi.en: Ayu doesn't want to join in judging the neighbor who rarely leaves the house.
w|menghakimi.ko: 아유는 집 밖에 잘 나오지 않는 이웃을 함께 흉보고 싶지 않아요.

w|menghalangi.en: A fallen tree is blocking the main road.

w|menghalangi.text: Menghalangi orang lain bukan sikap baik.
w|menghalangi.en: Blocking other people is not a good attitude.
w|menghalangi.ko: 다른 사람을 가로막는 건 좋은 태도가 아니야.

w|menghantam.text: Rudi juga bercerita bahwa ombak besar menghantam perahu nelayan di desanya minggu lalu.
w|menghantam.en: Rudi also told how big waves struck the fishing boats in his village last week.
w|menghantam.ko: 루디는 지난주 큰 파도가 마을 어선들을 덮쳤다는 이야기도 했어요.

w|menghantam.text: Krisis ekonomi menghantam banyak perusahaan rintisan kecil tahun ini.
w|menghantam.en: The economic crisis hit many small startups this year.
w|menghantam.ko: 올해 경제 위기가 작은 스타트업 여러 곳을 강타했어요.

w|menghantui.text: Kesalahan kecil di kantor lama masih menghantui pikiran Rina.
w|menghantui.en: A small mistake at her old office still haunts Rina's mind.
w|menghantui.ko: 예전 회사에서 한 작은 실수가 아직도 리나의 머릿속을 맴돌아요.

w|menghantui.text: Para pegawai suka bercerita tentang hantu yang konon menghantui lantai tiga.
w|menghantui.en: The staff like telling stories about a ghost that supposedly haunts the third floor.
w|menghantui.ko: 직원들은 삼 층에 귀신이 나온다는 이야기를 즐겨 해요.

w|menghapus.text: Dia menghapus catatan lama dari papan.
w|menghapus.en: He erased the old notes from the board.

w|mengharap.text: Para petani di desa Dimas mengharap hujan turun minggu ini.
w|mengharap.en: The farmers in Dimas's village are hoping for rain this week.
w|mengharap.ko: 디마스네 마을 농부들은 이번 주에 비가 내리기를 바라고 있어요.

w|mengharap.text: Putri mengharap kabar baik dari perusahaan yang dia lamar.
w|mengharap.en: Putri is hoping for good news from the company she applied to.
w|mengharap.ko: 푸트리는 지원한 회사에서 좋은 소식이 오기를 바라고 있어요.

w|mengharapkan.en: We are hoping for good news.
Don't expect quick results too much.

w|menghasilkan.en: That venture is starting to make money.

w|menghemat.text: Fajar sering belanja saat ada gratis ongkir supaya bisa menghemat uang.
w|menghemat.en: Fajar often shops when there's free shipping so he can save money.
w|menghemat.ko: 파자르는 돈을 아끼려고 무료 배송일 때 자주 쇼핑해요.

w|menghemat.text: Guru mengajari cara menghemat minyak saat menggoreng tahu.
w|menghemat.en: The teacher taught how to save oil when frying tofu.
w|menghemat.ko: 선생님은 두부를 튀길 때 기름을 아끼는 법을 가르쳐 줬어요.

w|menghentikan.en: He tried to stop the fight.

w|menghibur.en: That clown is good at entertaining children.
w|menghibur.ko: 그 광대가 아이들을 잘 즐겁게 해.

w|menghibur.text: Teman datang menghibur setelah dia sedih.
w|menghibur.en: A friend came to cheer her up after she was sad.
w|menghibur.ko: 슬플 때 친구가 와서 위로해 줬어.

w|menghidupkan.text: Tolong menghidupkan lampu di ruang tamu.
w|menghidupkan.en: Please turn on the light in the living room.

w|menghidupkan.text: Mereka berhasil menghidupkan kembali mesin tua itu.
w|menghidupkan.en: They managed to revive that old machine.
w|menghidupkan.ko: 그들은 그 낡은 기계를 다시 살리는 데 성공했어.

w|menghilangkan.text: Obat ini membantu menghilangkan rasa sakit.
w|menghilangkan.en: This medicine helps eliminate the pain.
w|menghilangkan.ko: 이 약이 통증을 없애는 데 도와줘.

w|menghilangkan.text: Dia ingin menghilangkan jejak masa lalu.
w|menghilangkan.en: He wants to erase the traces of the past.

w|menghina.text: Jangan menghina orang yang sedang kesulitan.
w|menghina.en: Do not insult people who are struggling.
His words insulted his classmate's feelings.
w|menghina.ko: 그의 말이 반 친구의 기분을 상하게 했어.

w|menghindar.text: Wali kota berusaha menghindar dari wartawan yang menunggu di tangga depan.
w|menghindar.en: The mayor tried to avoid the reporters waiting on the front steps.
w|menghindar.ko: 시장은 앞 계단에서 기다리는 기자들을 피하려고 했어요.

w|menghindar.text: Wati tidak bisa menghindar lagi dari ujian piano bulan depan.
w|menghindar.en: Wati can't avoid next month's piano exam any longer.
w|menghindar.ko: 와티는 다음 달 피아노 시험을 더는 피할 수 없어요.

w|menghipnotis.text: Rina bercanda bahwa Budi pasti sudah menghipnotis Ibu supaya selalu dibela.
w|menghipnotis.en: Rina joked that Budi must have hypnotized Mom so she would always take his side.
w|menghipnotis.ko: 리나는 부디가 엄마를 최면에 걸어서 늘 편을 들게 만든 게 분명하다고 농담했어요.

w|menghipnotis.text: Pemandangan sawah dari jendela baru seolah menghipnotis Siti.
w|menghipnotis.en: The view of the rice fields from the new window seemed to hypnotize Siti.
w|menghipnotis.ko: 새 창문으로 보이는 논 풍경에 시티는 넋을 잃은 듯했어요.

w|menghirup.text: Eko menghirup udara laut dalam-dalam sambil menutup mata.
w|menghirup.en: Eko breathed in the sea air deeply with his eyes closed.
w|menghirup.ko: 에코는 눈을 감고 바다 공기를 깊이 들이마셨어요.

w|menghirup.text: Ayu menghirup aroma rendang dari dapur Bu Sri.
w|menghirup.en: Ayu breathed in the smell of rendang from Mrs. Sri's kitchen.
w|menghirup.ko: 아유는 스리 아주머니 부엌에서 나는 른당 냄새를 들이마셨어요.

w|menghitung.en: That child is counting his money.
w|menghitung.ko: 그 아이는 자기 돈을 세고 있어.

w|menghubungi.en: It's hard to reach him now.

w|menghubungkan.text: Guru Eko memasang kabel untuk menghubungkan laptop dengan proyektor.
w|menghubungkan.en: Eko's teacher plugged in a cable to connect the laptop to the projector.
w|menghubungkan.ko: 에코의 선생님은 노트북을 프로젝터에 연결하려고 케이블을 꽂았어요.

w|menghubungkan.text: Kakak Ayu sibuk menghubungkan televisi baru ke internet.
w|menghubungkan.en: Ayu's older brother is busy connecting the new TV to the internet.
w|menghubungkan.ko: 아유의 오빠는 새 텔레비전을 인터넷에 연결하느라 바빠요.

w|menghukum.en: The judge will punish that offender.

w|menghukum.text: Menghukum anak dengan marah tidak membantu.
w|menghukum.en: Punishing a child in anger does not help.
w|menghukum.ko: 화나서 아이를 벌주는 건 도움이 안 돼.

w|mengidentifikasi.text: Para ahli masih berusaha mengidentifikasi asal patung batu tanpa kepala itu.
w|mengidentifikasi.en: Experts are still trying to identify the origin of the headless stone statue.
w|mengidentifikasi.ko: 전문가들은 머리 없는 그 돌 조각상의 출처를 아직 밝히려 하고 있어요.

w|mengidentifikasi.text: Dengan sekali cium, Rina bisa mengidentifikasi beras wangi asli.
w|mengidentifikasi.en: With one sniff, Rina can identify genuine fragrant rice.
w|mengidentifikasi.ko: 리나는 냄새 한 번만 맡아도 진짜 향미를 알아봐요.

w|mengikat.text: Dia mengikat tali sepatu dengan rapat.

w|mengikat.en: Please tie the package before it is sent.

w|menginap.text: Kami akan menginap di hotel dekat pantai.
w|menginap.en: We will stay overnight at a hotel near the beach.
w|menginap.ko: 우리는 해변 근처 호텔에 묵을 거야.

w|menginap.text: Dia menginap di rumah teman semalam.
w|menginap.en: He stayed overnight at a friend's house last night.

w|mengincar.text: Dimas sudah lama mengincar buku resep yang selalu dipinjam orang.
w|mengincar.en: Dimas has long had his eye on a cookbook that someone always borrows.
w|mengincar.ko: 디마스는 늘 대출 중인 요리책을 오래전부터 노리고 있었어요.

w|mengincar.text: Pencopet biasanya mengincar penumpang yang tertidur di kereta malam.
w|mengincar.en: Pickpockets usually target passengers who fall asleep on night trains.
w|mengincar.ko: 소매치기는 보통 밤 기차에서 잠든 승객을 노려요.

w|mengingat.en: It's hard to remember every detail.

w|mengingatkan.text: Ibu mengingatkan aku untuk membawa jaket.
w|mengingatkan.en: Mom reminded me to bring a jacket.

w|mengingatkan.text: Mengingatkan dia tentang janji itu penting.
w|mengingatkan.en: Reminding him about that promise is important.
w|mengingatkan.ko: 그 약속에 대해 그를 상기시키는 게 중요해.

w|menginjak.text: Rudi tidak sengaja menginjak paku dan langsung dibawa ke klinik.
w|menginjak.en: Rudi accidentally stepped on a nail and was taken straight to the clinic.
w|menginjak.ko: 루디는 실수로 못을 밟아서 바로 진료소에 실려 갔어요.

w|menginjak.text: Rina tidak sengaja menginjak kabel dan laptop rekannya hampir jatuh.
w|menginjak.en: Rina accidentally stepped on a cable and her colleague's laptop nearly fell.
w|menginjak.ko: 리나가 실수로 전선을 밟아서 동료의 노트북이 떨어질 뻔했어요.

w|menginterogasi.text: Dalam berita di radio toko, polisi masih menginterogasi tersangka pencurian.
w|menginterogasi.en: In the news on the shop's radio, police were still interrogating the theft suspect.
w|menginterogasi.ko: 가게 라디오 뉴스에서는 경찰이 아직 절도 용의자를 조사하고 있다고 했어요.

w|menginterogasi.text: Di film yang ditonton Lestari semalam, detektif menginterogasi seorang pelari.
w|menginterogasi.en: In the film Lestari watched last night, a detective interrogated a runner.
w|menginterogasi.ko: 레스타리가 어젯밤 본 영화에서 형사가 한 달리기 선수를 심문했어요.

w|mengintip.text: Beberapa siswa mengintip nilai ujian lewat jendela ruang guru.
w|mengintip.en: Some students peeked at the exam results through the staff room window.
w|mengintip.ko: 몇몇 학생이 교무실 창문으로 시험 점수를 몰래 엿봤어요.

w|mengintip.text: Siti mengintip daftar tamu untuk melihat apakah mantan ketua kelas datang.
w|mengintip.en: Siti peeked at the guest list to see whether the former class president was coming.
w|mengintip.ko: 시티는 전 반장이 오는지 보려고 방명록을 슬쩍 봤어요.

w|mengira.en: I thought you had already left.
w|mengira.ko: 난 네가 이미 간 줄 알았어.

w|mengirim.en: He forgot to send the letter.

w|mengirimi.text: Setiap bulan Dimas mengirimi pemilik hewan pengingat jadwal vaksinasi.
w|mengirimi.en: Every month Dimas sends pet owners reminders of the vaccination schedule.
w|mengirimi.ko: 디마스는 매달 반려동물 주인들에게 예방접종 일정 알림을 보내요.

w|mengirimi.text: Putri mengirimi pembimbingnya hasil percobaan lewat surel.
w|mengirimi.en: Putri sent her supervisor the experiment results by email.
w|mengirimi.ko: 푸트리는 지도교수에게 실험 결과를 이메일로 보냈어요.

w|mengirimkan.text: Dia mengirimkan paket ke luar kota.
w|mengirimkan.en: She sent a package out of town.
The office will send official invitations.

w|mengisap.text: Asisten dokter memakai alat kecil untuk mengisap air liur Agus.
w|mengisap.en: The dental assistant used a small tool to suck up Agus's saliva.
w|mengisap.ko: 치과 보조원이 작은 기구로 아구스의 침을 빨아들였어요.

w|mengisap.text: Wati memakai mesin penyedot untuk mengisap debu dari celah lantai kayu.
w|mengisap.en: Wati used a vacuum to suck the dust out of the gaps in the wooden floor.
w|mengisap.ko: 와티는 청소기로 나무 바닥 틈의 먼지를 빨아들였어요.

w|mengisi.text: Tolong mengisi formulir ini dengan lengkap.
w|mengisi.en: Please fill out this form completely.

w|mengisi.text: Dia sedang mengisi botol dengan air dingin.
w|mengisi.en: She is filling the bottle with cold water.
w|mengisi.ko: 그는 병에 차가운 물을 채우고 있어.

w|mengizinkan.text: Ibu mengizinkan kami bermain di luar.
w|mengizinkan.en: Mom allowed us to play outside.

w|mengizinkan.text: Guru tidak mengizinkan HP di kelas.
w|mengizinkan.en: The teacher does not allow phones in class.
w|mengizinkan.ko: 선생님이 수업 중 폰을 허락하지 않아.

w|mengkhawatirkan.text: Kondisi jalan itu mengkhawatirkan para pengemudi.
w|mengkhawatirkan.en: That road condition worries the drivers.
His test result worried his parents.

w|mengkhianati.en: He will not betray his friends.

w|mengklaim.text: Seorang bapak mengklaim bahwa buku yang hilang itu sudah ia kembalikan.
w|mengklaim.en: A man claimed that he had already returned the missing book.
w|mengklaim.ko: 한 아저씨는 없어진 책을 이미 반납했다고 주장했어요.

w|mengklaim.text: Seorang penumpang mengklaim kursi Putri, padahal tiketnya untuk gerbong lain.
w|mengklaim.en: A passenger claimed Putri's seat, even though his ticket was for another carriage.
w|mengklaim.ko: 한 승객이 푸트리 자리를 자기 자리라고 우겼는데 표는 다른 칸 것이었어요.

w|mengklik.text: Di kantor proyek, Rudi mengklik tombol kirim untuk melaporkan kemajuan harian.
w|mengklik.en: At the site office, Rudi clicked the send button to report the daily progress.
w|mengklik.ko: 루디는 현장 사무실에서 전송 버튼을 눌러 그날 진척 상황을 보고했어요.

w|mengklik.text: Rina diminta mengklik tautan untuk mengaktifkan email kantornya.
w|mengklik.en: Rina was asked to click a link to activate her work email.
w|mengklik.ko: 리나는 회사 이메일을 활성화하려고 링크를 눌러 달라는 안내를 받았어요.

w|mengobati.text: Dimas sudah sepuluh tahun mengobati hewan di kota kecil itu.
w|mengobati.en: Dimas has been treating animals in that small town for ten years.
w|mengobati.ko: 디마스는 그 작은 도시에서 십 년째 동물을 치료하고 있어요.

w|mengobati.text: Tim Putri meneliti senyawa dari daun sirih untuk mengobati infeksi kulit.
w|mengobati.en: Putri's team is studying a compound from betel leaves to treat skin infections.
w|mengobati.ko: 푸트리 팀은 피부 감염을 치료하려고 구장잎 성분을 연구해요.

w|mengobrol.text: Waktu jam kosong, Budi dan Andi mengobrol di bangku belakang.
w|mengobrol.en: During a free period, Budi and Andi chatted in the back row.
w|mengobrol.ko: 자습 시간에 부디와 안디는 뒷자리에서 수다를 떨었어요.

w|mengobrol.text: Sambil istirahat, Siti mengobrol dengan ibu-ibu tetangga di teras.
w|mengobrol.en: While taking a break, Siti chatted with the neighborhood women on the porch.
w|mengobrol.ko: 쉬는 동안 시티는 테라스에서 이웃 아주머니들과 이야기를 나눴어요.

w|mengonfirmasi.text: Hasil laboratorium mengonfirmasi bahwa anjing itu terkena cacing jantung.
w|mengonfirmasi.en: The lab results confirmed that the dog had heartworm.
w|mengonfirmasi.ko: 검사 결과 그 개가 심장사상충에 걸린 게 확인됐어요.

w|mengonfirmasi.text: Putri menelepon pemasok untuk mengonfirmasi pengiriman bahan kimia.
w|mengonfirmasi.en: Putri called the supplier to confirm the chemical delivery.
w|mengonfirmasi.ko: 푸트리는 화학약품 배송을 확인하려고 공급업체에 전화했어요.

w|mengontrol.text: Dia belajar mengontrol emosi saat stres.
w|mengontrol.en: She is learning to control emotions under stress.
w|mengontrol.ko: 그녀는 스트레스 속에서 감정을 조절하는 법을 배워.

w|mengontrol.text: Operator harus mengontrol mesin dengan teliti.
w|mengontrol.en: The operator must control the machine carefully.

w|mengorbankan.text: Dia bersedia mengorbankan waktu untuk keluarga.
w|mengorbankan.en: She is willing to sacrifice time for family.
w|mengorbankan.ko: 그는 가족을 위해 시간을 희생할 준비가 돼 있어.

w|mengosongkan.text: Sebelum musim hujan, Budi mengosongkan selokan dari sampah dan daun.
w|mengosongkan.en: Before the rainy season, Budi clears rubbish and leaves out of the gutter.
w|mengosongkan.ko: 우기가 오기 전에 부디는 도랑의 쓰레기와 낙엽을 치워요.

w|mengosongkan.text: Kru mengosongkan jalan selama satu jam untuk adegan kejar-kejaran.
w|mengosongkan.en: The crew cleared the street for an hour for the chase scene.
w|mengosongkan.ko: 제작진은 추격 장면을 위해 한 시간 동안 거리를 비웠어요.

w|menguap.text: Rudi menguap berkali-kali karena menulis surat itu sampai tengah malam.
w|menguap.en: Rudi yawned again and again because he wrote the letter until midnight.
w|menguap.ko: 루디는 자정까지 편지를 쓰느라 몇 번이나 하품을 했어요.

w|menguap.text: Rina menguap di depan laptop setelah bekerja semalaman.
w|menguap.en: Rina yawned in front of her laptop after working all night.
w|menguap.ko: 리나는 밤새 일한 뒤 노트북 앞에서 하품했어요.

w|menguasai.text: Dia sudah menguasai bahasa asing itu.
w|menguasai.en: She has already mastered that foreign language.
The troops managed to take control of that city.
w|menguasai.ko: 부대가 그 도시를 장악하는 데 성공했어.

w|mengubah.en: He wants to change his life.

w|mengubur.text: Mereka akan mengubur hewan peliharaan di kebun.
w|mengubur.en: They will bury the pet in the garden.
Don't bury your feelings for too long.
w|mengubur.ko: 감정을 너무 오래 묻어 두지 마.

w|menguburkan.text: Di desa itu, Agus ikut warga menguburkan seorang kakek yang meninggal karena usia tua.
w|menguburkan.en: In that village, Agus joined the residents in burying an old man who died of old age.
w|menguburkan.ko: 그 마을에서 아구스는 노환으로 돌아가신 할아버지의 장례를 주민들과 함께 치렀어요.

w|menguburkan.text: Wati izin dua hari untuk menguburkan neneknya di desa.
w|menguburkan.en: Wati took two days off to bury her grandmother in her village.
w|menguburkan.ko: 와티는 고향에서 할머니 장례를 치르려고 이틀 휴가를 냈어요.

w|mengucapkan.text: Dia mengucapkan terima kasih dengan tulus.

w|mengucapkan.en: Saying that word made him nervous.

w|menguji.text: Guru menguji pemahaman siswa hari ini.
w|menguji.en: The teacher tested the students' understanding today.

w|menguji.text: Mereka menguji mesin baru di pabrik.
w|menguji.en: They tested the new machine at the factory.

w|mengukur.text: Agus memakai aplikasi untuk mengukur jarak dari pantai ke penginapan.
w|mengukur.en: Agus used an app to measure the distance from the beach to the guesthouse.
w|mengukur.ko: 아구스는 앱으로 해변에서 숙소까지 거리를 쟀어요.

w|mengukur.text: Wati mengukur lingkar pinggang pelanggan sebelum memotong celana.
w|mengukur.en: Wati measured the customer's waist before shortening the trousers.
w|mengukur.ko: 와티는 바지를 줄이기 전에 손님의 허리둘레를 쟀어요.

w|mengulang.en: Can you repeat that once more?
I have to review this lesson.

w|mengulangi.text: Pelanggan senang dan berjanji akan mengulangi pesanan minggu depan.
w|mengulangi.en: The customer was happy and promised to repeat the order next week.
w|mengulangi.ko: 손님은 만족해서 다음 주에도 같은 주문을 하겠다고 했어요.

w|mengulangi.text: Lestari ingin mengulangi catatan waktu terbaiknya tahun lalu.
w|mengulangi.en: Lestari wants to repeat her best time from last year.
w|mengulangi.ko: 레스타리는 작년의 최고 기록을 다시 세우고 싶어 해요.

w|mengumpulkan.en: Raising funds takes a long time.

w|mengumumkan.text: Sekolah akan mengumumkan hasil ujian besok.
w|mengumumkan.en: The school will announce the exam results tomorrow.
w|mengumumkan.ko: 학교가 내일 시험 결과를 발표할 거야.

w|mengumumkan.en: They announced the opening of a new store.

w|mengunci.en: Don't forget to lock the door at night.
w|mengunci.ko: 밤에 문 잠그는 걸 잊지 마.

w|mengunci.en: Locking the safe makes him calm.

w|mengundang.en: Inviting the neighbors is a good idea.

w|mengundurkan.text: Pemimpin redaksi memutuskan mengundurkan diri setelah dua puluh tahun bekerja di koran itu.
w|mengundurkan.en: The editor-in-chief decided to resign after twenty years at the newspaper.
w|mengundurkan.ko: 편집국장은 그 신문사에서 이십 년을 일한 끝에 물러나기로 했어요.

w|mengundurkan.text: Teknisi senior di toko Ayu mengundurkan diri karena ingin membuka usaha sendiri.
w|mengundurkan.en: The senior technician at Ayu's shop resigned because he wants to open his own business.
w|mengundurkan.ko: 아유 가게 선임 기술자는 자기 가게를 차리고 싶어서 그만뒀어요.

w|mengungkap.text: Petugas museum di Solo mengungkap sejarah keraton yang jarang diceritakan.
w|mengungkap.en: A museum officer in Solo revealed palace history that is rarely told.
w|mengungkap.ko: 솔로의 박물관 직원은 잘 알려지지 않은 왕궁 역사를 들려줬어요.

w|mengungkap.text: Rekaman kamera akhirnya mengungkap siapa yang mengambil dompet di ruang ganti.
w|mengungkap.en: The camera footage finally revealed who took the wallet in the fitting room.
w|mengungkap.ko: 카메라 영상으로 탈의실에서 지갑을 가져간 사람이 드디어 밝혀졌어요.

w|mengungkapkan.en: She dared to express her opinion.
w|mengungkapkan.ko: 그녀는 자기 의견을 말할 용기가 있었어.

w|mengungkapkan.text: Surat itu mengungkapkan rasa terima kasih.

w|mengunjungi.text: Kami akan mengunjungi nenek minggu ini.
w|mengunjungi.en: We will visit grandma this week.
Visiting a museum is very educational.

w|menguntungkan.text: Kontrak dengan pembeli dari luar negeri sangat menguntungkan pabrik.
w|menguntungkan.en: The contract with the overseas buyer is very profitable for the factory.
w|menguntungkan.ko: 해외 바이어와의 계약은 공장에 아주 이득이 돼요.

w|menguntungkan.text: Tiket promo itu sangat menguntungkan bagi Intan yang sering bepergian.
w|menguntungkan.en: That promo ticket is very advantageous for Intan, who travels often.
w|menguntungkan.ko: 그 특가 항공권은 자주 여행하는 인탄에게 아주 이득이에요.

w|mengunyah.text: Anjing tetangga suka mengunyah sandal yang ditaruh di depan pintu Bayu.
w|mengunyah.en: The neighbor's dog likes to chew the sandals left in front of Bayu's door.
w|mengunyah.ko: 이웃집 개는 바유 집 문 앞에 둔 슬리퍼를 즐겨 씹어요.

w|mengunyah.text: Anak kecil di kursi depan sibuk mengunyah permen karet.
w|mengunyah.en: The little child in the front seat was busy chewing gum.

w|mengurangi.text: Dia mencoba mengurangi gula dalam kopi.
w|mengurangi.en: He is trying to reduce sugar in his coffee.

w|mengurangi.ko: 운동이 스트레스를 줄이는 데 도움이 돼.

w|mengurung.text: Hujan deras mengurung para murid di dalam kelas sampai sore.
w|mengurung.en: Heavy rain kept the students stuck in the classroom until the afternoon.
w|mengurung.ko: 폭우 때문에 학생들은 오후까지 교실에 갇혀 있었어요.

w|mengurung.text: Ibu Ayu mengurung ayam di kandang karena mau hujan.
w|mengurung.en: Ayu's mother shut the chickens in the coop because it was about to rain.
w|mengurung.ko: 비가 올 것 같아서 아유의 어머니는 닭을 닭장에 가뒀어요.

w|mengurusi.text: Bu Ani mengurusi semua keluhan penghuni di kantor pengelola.
w|mengurusi.en: Mrs. Ani handles all residents' complaints at the management office.
w|mengurusi.ko: 아니 씨가 관리사무소에서 입주민 불만을 모두 처리해요.

w|mengurusi.text: Kondektur mengurusi penumpang yang salah naik kereta.
w|mengurusi.en: The conductor dealt with a passenger who had boarded the wrong train.
w|mengurusi.ko: 차장이 기차를 잘못 탄 승객을 처리했어요.

w|mengusahakan.text: Serikat pekerja mengusahakan kenaikan gaji untuk semua buruh.
w|mengusahakan.en: The workers' union is working to secure a pay rise for all workers.
w|mengusahakan.ko: 노동조합은 모든 노동자의 임금 인상을 위해 애쓰고 있어요.

w|mengusahakan.text: Maskapai mengusahakan kursi lain untuk Intan karena penerbangannya penuh.
w|mengusahakan.en: The airline tried to find another seat for Intan because her flight was full.
w|mengusahakan.ko: 비행기가 만석이라 항공사가 인탄에게 다른 좌석을 마련해 주려고 애썼어요.

w|mengusir.text: Mereka mencoba mengusir burung dari sawah.
w|mengusir.en: They try to drive birds from the rice field.
Driving away a rude guest feels hard.

w|mengutuk.text: Di pelajaran sejarah, Eko membaca bahwa banyak negara mengutuk perang itu.
w|mengutuk.en: In history class, Eko read that many countries condemned that war.
w|mengutuk.ko: 역사 시간에 에코는 많은 나라가 그 전쟁을 규탄했다는 걸 읽었어요.

w|mengutuk.text: Di sinetron yang ditonton nenek Ayu, seorang ibu mengutuk anaknya jadi batu.
w|mengutuk.en: In the soap opera Ayu's grandmother watches, a mother curses her son into stone.
w|mengutuk.ko: 아유의 할머니가 보는 드라마에서 한 어머니가 아들을 돌로 변하게 저주해요.

w|mengutus.text: Dinas peternakan mengutus Dimas ke desa yang terkena wabah flu burung.
w|mengutus.en: The livestock agency sent Dimas to a village hit by a bird flu outbreak.
w|mengutus.ko: 축산청은 조류 독감이 번진 마을로 디마스를 파견했어요.

w|mengutus.text: Kampus mengutus Putri untuk presentasi di konferensi kimia.
w|mengutus.en: The university sent Putri to present at a chemistry conference.
w|mengutus.ko: 대학은 화학 학회에서 발표하도록 푸트리를 보냈어요.

w|menikah.en: She's not ready to marry yet.

w|menikahi.text: Dia akan menikahi kekasihnya tahun depan.
w|menikahi.en: He will marry his sweetheart next year.

w|menikahi.text: Menikahi orang yang dicintai adalah impiannya.
w|menikahi.en: Marrying the person he loves is his dream.
w|menikahi.ko: 사랑하는 사람과 결혼하는 게 그의 꿈이야.

w|menikam.text: Rudi bilang berita tentang pria yang menikam tetangganya membuat warga kompleks resah.
w|menikam.en: Rudi said the news about a man who stabbed his neighbor has made the residents uneasy.
w|menikam.ko: 루디는 이웃을 칼로 찌른 남자에 관한 뉴스 때문에 동네 주민들이 불안해한다고 했어요.

w|menikam.text: Rina kecewa karena mantan rekannya menikam dari belakang dengan mencuri ide aplikasinya.
w|menikam.en: Rina was disappointed because her former partner stabbed her in the back by stealing her app idea.
w|menikam.ko: 리나는 예전 동업자가 앱 아이디어를 훔쳐 뒤통수를 쳐서 실망했어요.

w|menikmati.ko: 그는 아침 커피를 즐기는 걸 좋아해.

w|menilai.text: Guru mulai menilai tugas para siswa.
w|menilai.en: The teacher began to grade the students' work.

w|menilai.text: Jangan menilai orang dari penampilan saja.
w|menilai.en: Don't judge people by appearance alone.

w|menimbulkan.en: The noise caused complaints from the neighbors.
That decision caused a long debate.

w|menimpa.text: Waktu badai datang, sebatang pohon kelapa menimpa atap kandang Budi.
w|menimpa.en: When the storm came, a coconut tree fell onto the roof of Budi's shed.
w|menimpa.ko: 폭풍이 왔을 때 야자나무 한 그루가 부디네 외양간 지붕 위로 쓰러졌어요.

w|menimpa.text: Musibah yang menimpa tokoh Siti membuat penonton tes menangis.
w|menimpa.en: The misfortune that befell Siti's character made the test audience cry.
w|menimpa.ko: 시티가 맡은 인물에게 닥친 불행에 시사회 관객들이 울었어요.

w|meninggal.en: My grandpa passed away last year.

w|meningkat.text: Jumlah pengunjung meningkat setiap musim panas.

w|meningkatkan.ko: 규칙적인 연습이 스태미나를 높일 수 있어.

w|meningkatkan.text: Meningkatkan kualitas produk jadi fokus kami.
w|meningkatkan.en: Improving product quality is our focus.
w|meningkatkan.ko: 제품 품질을 높이는 게 우리 초점이야.

w|menipu.text: Menipu orang lain akan berbalik padamu.
w|menipu.en: Deceiving others will come back to you.

w|meniru.text: Anak-anak tertawa saat Andi meniru gaya bicara kepala sekolah.
w|meniru.en: The kids laughed when Andi imitated the principal's way of speaking.
w|meniru.ko: 안디가 교장 선생님 말투를 흉내 내자 아이들이 웃었어요.

w|meniru.text: Anak kecil di bangsal anak suka meniru cara Dewi memakai stetoskop.
w|meniru.en: The little child on the children's ward likes to copy how Dewi uses a stethoscope.
w|meniru.ko: 소아 병동 꼬마는 데위가 청진기 쓰는 모습을 흉내 내는 걸 좋아해요.

w|menit.en: That trip is only ten minutes.

w|meniup.text: Di ruang alat musik, Rudi mencoba meniup seruling bambu tiruan.
w|meniup.en: In the musical instrument room, Rudi tried blowing a replica bamboo flute.
w|meniup.ko: 악기 전시실에서 루디는 대나무 피리 모형을 불어 봤어요.

w|meniup.text: Penjual kerupuk meniup plastik dulu sebelum mengisinya.
w|meniup.en: The cracker seller blows into the plastic bag before filling it.
w|meniup.ko: 과자 장수는 봉지를 채우기 전에 먼저 후 불어 벌려요.

w|menjadi.en: They want to be a teacher.

w|menjadikan.text: Jangan menjadikan masalah kecil jadi besar.
w|menjadikan.en: Don't turn a small problem into a big one.

w|menjalani.en: He is going through tough training.

w|menjalani.text: Kita harus menjalani hidup dengan jujur.

w|menjamin.en: The company guarantees the quality of its products.

w|menjanjikan.text: Hasil uji coba itu menjanjikan untuk masa depan.
w|menjanjikan.en: Those test results are promising for the future.

w|menjanjikan.text: Pemain muda itu menjanjikan bakat yang besar.
w|menjanjikan.en: That young player shows great promise.
w|menjanjikan.ko: 그 젊은 선수는 큰 재능을 보여줘.

w|menjatuhkan.en: Strong wind can knock down trees.
w|menjatuhkan.ko: 거센 바람이 나무를 쓰러뜨릴 수 있어.

w|menjauh.en: Please stay away from the fire.
He started to move away from the crowd.

w|menjauhi.text: Para pekerja disuruh menjauhi area di bawah derek.
w|menjauhi.en: The workers were told to stay away from the area under the crane.
w|menjauhi.ko: 인부들은 크레인 아래 구역에 가까이 가지 말라는 지시를 받았어요.

w|menjauhi.text: Rina berusaha menjauhi gosip kantor sejak hari pertama.
w|menjauhi.en: Rina tries to stay away from office gossip from day one.
w|menjauhi.ko: 리나는 첫날부터 사내 뒷말에서 멀리 있으려고 해요.

w|menjauhkan.text: Dia mencoba menjauhkan diri dari masalah.
w|menjauhkan.en: He tried to distance himself from trouble.

w|menjebak.en: The police managed to trap that thief.

w|menjebak.text: Jangan menjebak teman dengan pertanyaan sulit.
w|menjebak.en: Don't trap a friend with hard questions.
w|menjebak.ko: 어려운 질문으로 친구를 함정에 빠뜨리지 마.

w|menjelaskan.en: The teacher explained the lesson clearly.

w|menjemput.en: Dad will pick me up at school.
w|menjemput.ko: 아버지가 학교에서 나를 데리러 오실 거야.

w|menjemput.text: Menjemput tamu di bandara adalah tugasnya.
w|menjemput.en: Picking up guests at the airport is his job.
w|menjemput.ko: 공항에서 손님을 마중하는 게 그의 일이야.

w|menjengkelkan.en: That sound is very annoying to the ears.

w|menjengkelkan.text: Sikapnya menjengkelkan semua orang di ruangan.
w|menjengkelkan.en: His attitude annoyed everyone in the room.
w|menjengkelkan.ko: 그의 태도가 방 안 모두를 짜증나게 했어.

w|menjerit.text: Anak itu menjerit ketika melihat ular.
w|menjerit.en: That child screamed when seeing a snake.
w|menjerit.ko: 그 아이가 뱀을 보고 비명을 질렀어.

w|menjual.text: Dia menjual buah di pasar pagi.
w|menjual.en: He sells fruit at the morning market.

w|menjual.text: Mereka menjual mobil lama minggu lalu.
w|menjual.en: They sold the old car last week.

w|mental.text: Kesehatan mental sama pentingnya dengan tubuh.
w|mental.en: Mental health is as important as the body.

w|mental.text: Mental yang kuat membantu menghadapi tekanan.
w|mental.en: A strong mind helps face pressure.

w|mentega.text: Croissant di toko Fajar dibuat dengan mentega asli, bukan margarin.
w|mentega.en: The croissants at Fajar's shop are made with real butter, not margarine.
w|mentega.ko: 파자르네 가게의 크루아상은 마가린이 아니라 진짜 버터로 만들어요.

w|mentega.text: Untuk sarapan, Lestari makan roti dengan sedikit mentega kacang.
w|mentega.en: For breakfast, Lestari ate bread with a little peanut butter.
w|mentega.ko: 레스타리는 아침으로 땅콩버터를 조금 바른 빵을 먹었어요.

w|menteri.en: The new minister was appointed yesterday.

w|menu.text: Bulan ini toko Fajar menambah menu roti tawar gandum.
w|menu.en: This month Fajar's shop added whole-wheat bread to the menu.
w|menu.ko: 이번 달 파자르네 가게는 통밀 식빵을 메뉴에 추가했어요.

w|menu.text: Hotel tempat Lestari menginap punya menu khusus untuk atlet.
w|menu.en: The hotel where Lestari stayed has a special menu for athletes.
w|menu.ko: 레스타리가 묵은 호텔에는 운동선수를 위한 특별 메뉴가 있어요.

w|menuangkan.text: Bayu menuangkan teh hangat ke gelas tetangganya yang mampir.
w|menuangkan.en: Bayu poured warm tea into the glass of the neighbor who dropped by.
w|menuangkan.ko: 바유는 들른 이웃의 잔에 따뜻한 차를 따랐어요.

w|menuangkan.text: Seorang bapak menuangkan kopi dari termos untuk Intan.
w|menuangkan.en: A man poured coffee from a thermos for Intan.
w|menuangkan.ko: 한 아저씨가 보온병에서 커피를 따라 인탄에게 줬어요.

w|menuduh.text: Jangan menuduh orang tanpa bukti kuat.
w|menuduh.en: Don't accuse people without strong evidence.
w|menuduh.ko: 확실한 증거 없이 남을 비난하지 마.

w|menuduh.en: He accused his friend of stealing his wallet.

w|menugaskan.text: Fajar menugaskan pegawai barunya untuk menjaga kasir.
w|menugaskan.en: Fajar assigned his new employee to look after the till.

w|menugaskan.text: Klub lari menugaskan Lestari untuk memimpin kelompok pemula.
w|menugaskan.en: The running club assigned Lestari to lead the beginners' group.
w|menugaskan.ko: 달리기 동호회는 레스타리에게 초보자 그룹을 이끄는 일을 맡겼어요.

w|menukar.text: Seorang penonton datang ke loket untuk menukar tiketnya ke jadwal besok.

w|menyita.en: Customs officers seized imported cloth that had no permit.
w|menyita.ko: 세관 직원이 허가 없는 수입 원단을 압수했어요.

w|menyita.text: Petugas menyita botol parfum besar dari tas kabin Intan.
w|menyita.en: The officer confiscated a large perfume bottle from Intan's cabin bag.
w|menyita.ko: 직원이 인탄의 기내 가방에서 큰 향수병을 압수했어요.

w|menyuap.text: Rina pernah menolak seorang pemasok yang mencoba menyuap timnya.
w|menyuap.en: Rina once turned down a supplier who tried to bribe her team.
w|menyuap.ko: 리나는 자기 팀에 뇌물을 주려던 납품업자를 거절한 적이 있어요.

w|menyuap.text: Seorang tamu mencoba menyuap satpam supaya bisa parkir di depan lobi.
w|menyuap.en: A guest tried to bribe the security guard so he could park in front of the lobby.
w|menyuap.ko: 한 손님이 로비 앞에 주차하려고 경비원에게 뒷돈을 주려 했어요.

w|menyuntik.text: Dimas menyuntik kambing itu dengan cepat sebelum hewan itu sempat berontak.
w|menyuntik.en: Dimas injected the goat quickly before the animal had a chance to struggle.
w|menyuntik.ko: 디마스는 염소가 버둥대기 전에 재빨리 주사를 놓았어요.

w|menyuntik.text: Asisten lab menyuntik tikus percobaan dengan cairan pewarna.
w|menyuntik.en: The lab assistant injected the test mice with a dye solution.
w|menyuntik.ko: 실험 조교가 실험용 쥐에게 염료 용액을 주사했어요.

w|menyuruh.en: Mom told me to clean the room.
Ordering other people around isn't a solution.

w|menyusul.text: Andi datang lebih dulu, lalu istrinya menyusul membawa fotokopi KTP.
w|menyusul.en: Andi came first, and then his wife followed with a photocopy of his ID card.
w|menyusul.ko: 안디가 먼저 오고, 아내가 신분증 사본을 들고 뒤따라왔어요.

w|menyusul.text: Setelah tertinggal di babak pertama, tim Dewi mulai menyusul skor lawan.
w|menyusul.en: After falling behind in the first half, Dewi's team started catching up with the opponent's score.
w|menyusul.ko: 전반에 뒤졌던 데위네 팀은 상대 점수를 따라잡기 시작했어요.

w|menyusun.text: Para tukang menyusun bata merah dengan rapi untuk dinding belakang.
w|menyusun.en: The builders laid red bricks neatly for the back wall.
w|menyusun.ko: 인부들이 뒷벽에 쓸 붉은 벽돌을 가지런히 쌓았어요.

w|menyusun.text: Sore itu Rina menyusun daftar tugas untuk minggu pertamanya.
w|menyusun.en: That afternoon Rina put together a to-do list for her first week.
w|menyusun.ko: 그날 오후 리나는 첫 주에 할 일 목록을 정리했어요.

w|menyusup.text: Sisa makanan bisa menyusup ke celah gigi dan menyebabkan lubang.
w|menyusup.en: Food remains can get into the gaps between teeth and cause cavities.
w|menyusup.ko: 음식 찌꺼기가 이 틈에 끼어 들어가 충치를 만들 수 있어요.

w|menyusup.text: Air hujan menyusup lewat celah genteng dan membasahi plafon.
w|menyusup.en: Rainwater seeped through the gaps in the roof tiles and soaked the ceiling.
w|menyusup.ko: 빗물이 기와 틈으로 스며들어 천장을 적셨어요.

w|meracuni.text: Menurut berita, pabrik di kota lain ditutup karena limbahnya meracuni sungai.
w|meracuni.en: According to the news, a factory in another city was shut down because its waste poisoned the river.
w|meracuni.ko: 뉴스에 따르면 다른 도시의 한 공장은 폐수로 강을 오염시켜 문을 닫았대요.

w|meracuni.text: Intan menonton film tentang ratu yang berusaha meracuni musuhnya.
w|meracuni.en: Intan watched a film about a queen who tries to poison her enemy.
w|meracuni.ko: 인탄은 적을 독살하려는 여왕에 관한 영화를 봤어요.

w|meragukan.en: I doubt the truth of that news.

w|merah.en: That red flower is very pretty.
Red is the color of courage.

w|merahasiakan.text: Budi merahasiakan nilai ulangannya dari kakaknya.
w|merahasiakan.en: Budi kept his test score a secret from his older sibling.
w|merahasiakan.ko: 부디는 시험 점수를 형에게 비밀로 했어요.

w|merahasiakan.text: Siti merahasiakan alamat barunya supaya bisa memberi kejutan kepada teman-teman.
w|merahasiakan.en: Siti kept her new address secret so she could surprise her friends.
w|merahasiakan.ko: 시티는 친구들을 깜짝 놀라게 하려고 새 주소를 비밀로 했어요.

w|meraih.text: Dia meraih gelas di rak paling atas.
w|meraih.en: She reached for a glass on the top shelf.
w|meraih.ko: 그는 맨 위 선반의 컵을 집었어.

w|meraih.text: Tim itu meraih kemenangan di final.
w|meraih.en: That team achieved victory in the final.

w|merampas.text: Ombak besar merampas sandal Eko yang tertinggal di pinggir air.
w|merampas.en: A big wave snatched away the sandals Eko had left at the water's edge.
w|merampas.ko: 큰 파도가 물가에 두고 온 에코의 샌들을 휩쓸어 갔어요.

w|merampas.text: Ayu membaca berita tentang preman yang merampas ponsel di jalan dekat rumahnya.
w|merampas.en: Ayu read news about a thug who snatched a phone on the street near her house.
w|merampas.ko: 아유는 집 근처 길에서 깡패가 휴대폰을 빼앗았다는 기사를 읽었어요.

w|merampok.text: Pencuri itu mencoba merampok toko kecil.
w|merampok.en: That thief tried to rob a small shop.
w|merampok.ko: 그 도둑이 작은 가게를 털려 했어.

w|merampok.text: Mereka tidak akan merampok orang lain.
w|merampok.en: They will not rob other people.
w|merampok.ko: 그들은 다른 사람을 강도질하지 않을 거야.

w|merancang.text: Para siswa kelas sebelas sedang merancang kostum untuk pentas seni.
w|merancang.en: The eleventh-grade students are designing costumes for the arts show.
w|merancang.ko: 고등학교 이 학년 학생들이 예술제 의상을 디자인하고 있어요.

w|merancang.text: Siti dan Rudi merancang acara reuni ini sejak tiga bulan lalu.
w|merancang.en: Siti and Rudi have been planning this reunion since three months ago.
w|merancang.ko: 시티와 루디는 석 달 전부터 이번 동창회를 계획했어요.

w|merangkak.text: Lalu lintas merangkak pelan, jadi Eko terlambat tiba di lokasi kebakaran.
w|merangkak.en: Traffic crawled along slowly, so Eko arrived late at the fire scene.
w|merangkak.ko: 차가 엉금엉금 기어가는 바람에 에코는 화재 현장에 늦게 도착했어요.

w|merangkak.text: Bayi pelanggan merangkak di lantai toko sementara ibunya menunggu.
w|merangkak.en: The customer's baby crawled on the shop floor while the mother waited.
w|merangkak.ko: 손님 아기가 엄마를 기다리는 동안 가게 바닥을 기어다녔어요.

w|merasuki.text: Rudi menulis bahwa rasa rindu seperti merasuki pikirannya setiap musim hujan.
w|merasuki.en: Rudi wrote that longing seems to take over his mind every rainy season.
w|merasuki.ko: 루디는 우기마다 그리움이 마음을 사로잡는 것 같다고 썼어요.

w|merasuki.text: Ide membuat aplikasi sendiri seolah merasuki Rina sejak kuliah.
w|merasuki.en: The idea of making her own app seems to have possessed Rina since university.
w|merasuki.ko: 자기만의 앱을 만들겠다는 생각이 대학 때부터 리나를 사로잡은 것 같아요.

w|merawat.text: Dia suka merawat tanaman di balkon.
w|merawat.en: She likes tending plants on the balcony.
w|merawat.ko: 그는 베란다 식물을 가꾸는 걸 좋아해.

w|merawat.text: Perawat itu merawat pasien dengan sabar.
w|merawat.en: That nurse cares for patients patiently.
w|merawat.ko: 그 간호사가 환자를 참을성 있게 돌봐.

w|merayakan.text: Kami merayakan ulang tahunnya di rumah.
w|merayakan.en: We celebrated her birthday at home.

w|merayu.text: Penjual mesin itu terus merayu Bayu supaya membeli model paling mahal.
w|merayu.en: The machine salesman kept sweet-talking Bayu into buying the most expensive model.
w|merayu.ko: 그 기계 판매원은 바유에게 가장 비싼 모델을 사라고 계속 꼬드겼어요.

w|merayu.text: Adik Intan merayu ibunya supaya dibelikan mainan di toko bandara.
w|merayu.en: Intan's little brother sweet-talked their mother into buying him a toy at the airport shop.
w|merayu.ko: 인탄의 동생은 공항 가게에서 장난감을 사 달라고 엄마를 졸랐어요.

w|merebut.text: Mereka mencoba merebut kembali kota itu.
w|merebut.en: They tried to seize the city back.

w|merebut.text: Anak itu merebut mainan dari adiknya.
w|merebut.en: That child snatched the toy from his sibling.

w|merekam.text: Mereka merekam wawancara di studio kecil.
w|merekam.en: They are recording the interview in a small studio.
w|merekam.ko: 그들은 작은 스튜디오에서 인터뷰를 녹음하고 있어.

w|merekomendasikan.text: Teman kantor Fajar merekomendasikan toko daring yang jual barang elektronik murah.
w|merekomendasikan.en: Fajar's office friend recommended an online shop that sells cheap electronics.
w|merekomendasikan.ko: 파자르의 회사 친구가 싼 전자제품을 파는 온라인 가게를 추천했어요.

w|merekomendasikan.text: Guru merekomendasikan gula aren untuk kolak supaya rasanya lebih harum.
w|merekomendasikan.en: The teacher recommended palm sugar for the kolak so it would taste more fragrant.
w|merekomendasikan.ko: 선생님은 콜락에 야자당을 넣으면 향이 더 좋다고 권했어요.

w|merekrut.text: Pabrik sedang merekrut tiga puluh penjahit untuk musim ramai.
w|merekrut.en: The factory is recruiting thirty tailors for the busy season.
w|merekrut.ko: 공장은 바쁜 철을 맞아 재봉사 서른 명을 뽑고 있어요.

w|merekrut.text: Maskapai itu sedang merekrut pilot muda lewat program beasiswa.
w|merekrut.en: The airline is recruiting young pilots through a scholarship program.
w|merekrut.ko: 그 항공사는 장학 프로그램으로 젊은 조종사를 뽑고 있어요.

w|meremehkan.text: Pak Agus mengingatkan Andi agar tidak meremehkan pesan penipuan di ponsel.
w|meremehkan.en: Mr. Agus reminded Andi not to underestimate scam messages on his phone.
w|meremehkan.ko: 아구스 경관은 안디에게 휴대폰 사기 문자를 가볍게 보지 말라고 했어요.

w|meremehkan.text: Lawan meremehkan tim Dewi, padahal akhirnya mereka kalah jauh.
w|meremehkan.en: The opponents underestimated Dewi's team, but in the end they lost by a wide margin.
w|meremehkan.ko: 상대 팀은 데위네 팀을 얕봤는데 결국 크게 졌어요.

w|merencanakan.en: We are planning a trip to the mountain.

w|merencanakan.text: Dia suka merencanakan semuanya jauh-jauh hari.
w|merencanakan.en: She likes to plan everything far in advance.
w|merencanakan.ko: 그는 모든 걸 미리미리 계획하는 걸 좋아해.

w|merendahkan.text: Fajar kesal karena ada penjual yang merendahkan pembeli di kolom komentar.
w|merendahkan.en: Fajar was annoyed because a seller belittled a buyer in the comments.
w|merendahkan.ko: 파자르는 한 판매자가 댓글 창에서 구매자를 깔보는 걸 보고 짜증이 났어요.

w|merendahkan.text: Guru yang baik tidak pernah merendahkan masakan peserta yang gagal.
w|merendahkan.en: A good teacher never belittles a participant's failed dish.
w|merendahkan.ko: 좋은 선생님은 참가자가 망친 요리를 절대 깔보지 않아요.

w|merenggut.text: Seorang warga bercerita bahwa banjir bandang pernah merenggut banyak rumah di lembah itu.
w|merenggut.en: A local resident told how a flash flood once swept away many houses in that valley.
w|merenggut.ko: 한 주민은 예전에 돌발 홍수가 그 골짜기의 집을 많이 앗아 갔다고 말했어요.

w|merenggut.text: Seorang pencopet merenggut tas seorang ibu di eskalator.
w|merenggut.en: A pickpocket snatched a woman's bag on the escalator.
w|merenggut.ko: 소매치기가 에스컬레이터에서 한 여성의 가방을 낚아챘어요.

w|merepotkan.text: Agus tidak mau merepotkan pamannya, jadi dia menginap di hotel kecil.
w|merepotkan.en: Agus didn't want to trouble his uncle, so he stayed at a small hotel.
w|merepotkan.ko: 아구스는 삼촌에게 폐를 끼치기 싫어서 작은 호텔에 묵었어요.

w|merepotkan.text: Wati sabar menghadapi pembeli yang suka merepotkan pegawai.
w|merepotkan.en: Wati is patient with customers who like to give staff a hard time.
w|merepotkan.ko: 와티는 직원을 귀찮게 하는 손님도 참을성 있게 대해요.

w|meretas.text: Anak Budi membaca berita tentang orang yang meretas situs badan cuaca.
w|meretas.en: Budi's son read a news story about someone who hacked the weather agency's website.
w|meretas.ko: 부디의 아들은 누군가 기상청 사이트를 해킹했다는 기사를 읽었어요.

w|meretas.text: Dalam film itu, tokoh adik Siti adalah remaja yang pandai meretas komputer.
w|meretas.en: In the film, the character of Siti's younger brother is a teenager who is good at hacking computers.
w|meretas.ko: 그 영화에서 시티의 동생 역은 컴퓨터 해킹을 잘하는 십 대예요.

w|meriam.text: Di halaman kantor polisi ada meriam tua peninggalan zaman penjajahan.
w|meriam.en: In the yard of the police station there is an old cannon from the colonial era.
w|meriam.ko: 경찰서 마당에는 식민지 시대에 남은 낡은 대포가 있어요.

w|meriam.text: Tembakan tiga angka Dewi melesat seperti peluru meriam.
w|meriam.en: Dewi's three-point shot flew like a cannonball.

w|merilis.text: Bulan ini pabrik merilis katalog kain motif batik yang baru.
w|merilis.en: This month the factory released a new catalogue of batik-pattern fabrics.
w|merilis.ko: 이번 달 공장은 바틱 무늬 원단 신제품 카탈로그를 냈어요.

w|merilis.text: Penyanyi favorit Intan baru merilis album dan kebetulan satu pesawat dengannya.
w|merilis.en: Intan's favorite singer just released an album and happened to be on the same plane.
w|merilis.ko: 인탄이 좋아하는 가수가 막 앨범을 냈는데 우연히 같은 비행기를 탔어요.

w|merobek.text: Dia merobek surat lama tanpa membaca.
w|merobek.en: He tore up the old letter without reading it.
w|merobek.ko: 그는 읽지도 않고 낡은 편지를 찢었어.

w|merokok.en: Smoking is prohibited inside the building.
w|merokok.ko: 건물 안에서는 담배를 피우면 안 돼.

w|mertua.text: Rina sedang belajar memasak rendang supaya disukai calon mertua.
w|mertua.en: Rina is learning to cook rendang so her future in-laws will like her.
w|mertua.ko: 리나는 예비 시부모님 마음에 들려고 른당 만드는 법을 배우고 있어요.

w|mertua.text: Dewi memesan kamar untuk mertua kakaknya yang datang dari Makassar.
w|mertua.en: Dewi booked a room for her sister's in-laws who came from Makassar.
w|mertua.ko: 데위는 마카사르에서 오는 언니의 시부모님 방을 예약했어요.

w|merunduk.text: Dia merunduk agar tidak terkena cabang pohon.
w|merunduk.en: He ducked so he would not hit the tree branch.
w|merunduk.ko: 그는 나뭇가지에 안 걸리려고 몸을 숙였어.

w|merunduk.text: Merunduk di balik meja membuatnya aman.
w|merunduk.en: Ducking behind the table kept her safe.
w|merunduk.ko: 탁자 뒤에 몸을 숙여서 그녀는 안전했어.

w|meski.en: Even though tired, he kept working.
I came even though it poured.

w|meskipun.en: Even though it was raining, he still came.
She kept smiling even though she was tired.

w|mesti.en: You must go home before dark.

w|mesti.text: Kita mesti jujur satu sama lain.
w|mesti.en: We must be honest with each other.

w|meter.en: That table is two meters long.
The water meter at home is broken.

w|metode.text: Guru menjelaskan metode belajar yang lebih mudah.
w|metode.en: The teacher explained an easier learning method.
w|metode.ko: 선생님이 더 쉬운 학습 방법을 설명했어.

w|metode.text: Metode ini sudah dipakai di banyak sekolah.
w|metode.en: This method is already used in many schools.
w|metode.ko: 이 방법은 이미 많은 학교에서 쓰여.

w|mewah.en: That luxury hotel faces the sea.
Luxurious does not always mean comfortable.

w|mewakili.text: Dia akan mewakili sekolah di kompetisi itu.
w|mewakili.en: She will represent the school in that competition.
w|mewakili.ko: 그는 그 대회에서 학교를 대표할 거야.

w|mewakili.text: Pengacara itu mewakili klien dengan baik.
w|mewakili.en: That lawyer represents the client well.

w|mewawancarai.text: Wartawan lokal mewawancarai Bayu tentang kondisi kerja di pabrik.
w|mewawancarai.en: A local journalist interviewed Bayu about working conditions at the factory.
w|mewawancarai.ko: 지역 기자가 공장 근무 환경에 대해 바유를 인터뷰했어요.

w|mewawancarai.text: Seorang reporter mewawancarai Intan tentang keterlambatan penerbangan.
w|mewawancarai.en: A reporter interviewed Intan about the flight delay.
w|mewawancarai.ko: 한 기자가 항공편 지연에 대해 인탄을 인터뷰했어요.

w|mewujudkan.text: Agus bekerja keras untuk mewujudkan taman bermain di setiap kelurahan.
w|mewujudkan.en: Agus works hard to make a playground in every urban ward a reality.
w|mewujudkan.ko: 아구스는 동마다 놀이터를 만들려고 열심히 일해요.

w|mewujudkan.text: Wati berlatih setiap hari untuk mewujudkan mimpinya bermain di orkestra.
w|mewujudkan.en: Wati practices every day to make her dream of playing in an orchestra come true.
w|mewujudkan.ko: 와티는 오케스트라에서 연주하는 꿈을 이루려고 매일 연습해요.

w|meyakini.text: Orang tua di desa Budi meyakini suara katak adalah tanda hujan akan turun.
w|meyakini.en: Elders in Budi's village believe the sound of frogs is a sign that rain is coming.
w|meyakini.ko: 부디네 마을 어르신들은 개구리 소리가 비 올 징조라고 믿어요.

w|meyakini.text: Siti meyakini film ini akan disukai penonton muda.
w|meyakini.en: Siti is convinced this film will be liked by young audiences.
w|meyakini.ko: 시티는 이 영화가 젊은 관객에게 사랑받을 거라고 믿어요.

w|meyakinkan.en: He managed to convince the team.

w|mie.text: Saat istirahat siang, Fajar makan mie ayam di warung sebelah.
w|mie.en: At lunch break, Fajar eats chicken noodles at the stall next door.
w|mie.ko: 점심시간에 파자르는 옆 노점에서 닭고기 국수를 먹어요.

w|mie.text: Lestari menghindari mie instan selama masa latihan.

w|perkiraan.ko: 시험 결과에 대한 안디의 예상은 너무 낙관적이었어요.

w|perkiraan.text: Menurut perkiraan dokter, luka operasi Dewi akan sembuh dalam dua minggu.
w|perkiraan.en: By the doctor's estimate, Dewi's surgical wound will heal in two weeks.
w|perkiraan.ko: 의사의 예상으로는 데위의 수술 상처가 이 주 안에 나을 거예요.

w|perkumpulan.text: Eko ikut perkumpulan pencinta alam di sekolahnya.
w|perkumpulan.en: Eko joined the nature lovers' club at his school.
w|perkumpulan.ko: 에코는 학교 자연 애호 모임에 들어갔어요.

w|perkumpulan.text: Ibu Ayu ikut perkumpulan arisan di kompleks rumahnya.
w|perkumpulan.en: Ayu's mother is in a rotating savings group in her housing complex.
w|perkumpulan.ko: 아유의 어머니는 동네 계 모임에 나가요.

w|perlahan.text: Mobil bergerak perlahan di jalan licin.
w|perlahan.en: The car moves slowly on the slippery road.

w|perlahan.text: Perlahan dia membuka pintu tua itu.
w|perlahan.en: Slowly she opened that old door.
w|perlahan.ko: 그녀가 천천히 그 낡은 문을 열었어.

w|perlahan-lahan.text: Pintu tahanan dibuka perlahan-lahan oleh petugas jaga.
w|perlahan-lahan.en: The cell door was opened slowly by the guard on duty.
w|perlahan-lahan.ko: 당직 경관이 유치장 문을 천천히 열었어요.

w|perlahan-lahan.text: Setelah cedera lutut, Dewi kembali berlatih perlahan-lahan.
w|perlahan-lahan.en: After her knee injury, Dewi slowly went back to training.
w|perlahan-lahan.ko: 무릎을 다친 뒤 데위는 천천히 다시 훈련을 시작했어요.

w|perlawanan.en: Residents' resistance stopped the construction plan.

w|perlawanan.text: Tim menunjukkan perlawanan keras sampai akhir.
w|perlawanan.en: The team showed tough resistance until the end.

w|perlengkapan.text: Ruang belajar menyediakan perlengkapan seperti stopkontak dan lampu meja.
w|perlengkapan.en: The study room provides equipment such as power outlets and desk lamps.
w|perlengkapan.ko: 열람실에는 콘센트와 책상 스탠드 같은 설비가 있어요.

w|perlengkapan.text: Putri membawa perlengkapan tidur kecil: bantal leher dan penutup mata.
w|perlengkapan.en: Putri brought a small sleeping kit: a neck pillow and an eye mask.
w|perlengkapan.ko: 푸트리는 목베개와 안대 같은 작은 수면 용품을 챙겼어요.

w|perlombaan.text: Kelompok teater Bayu memenangkan perlombaan drama tingkat provinsi.
w|perlombaan.en: Bayu's theatre group won the provincial drama competition.
w|perlombaan.ko: 바유의 극단이 도 단위 연극 대회에서 우승했어요.

w|perlombaan.text: Kantor Intan mengadakan perlombaan dekorasi meja menjelang tujuh belasan.
w|perlombaan.en: Intan's office held a desk-decorating contest ahead of Independence Day.
w|perlombaan.ko: 인탄의 회사는 독립기념일을 앞두고 책상 꾸미기 대회를 열었어요.

w|permanen.text: Kelompok teater Bayu akhirnya punya gedung latihan yang permanen.
w|permanen.en: Bayu's theatre group finally has a permanent rehearsal building.
w|permanen.ko: 바유의 극단은 드디어 고정된 연습실 건물을 갖게 됐어요.

w|permanen.text: Setelah masa percobaan, Intan akhirnya diangkat menjadi karyawan permanen.
w|permanen.en: After her probation, Intan was finally made a permanent employee.
w|permanen.ko: 수습 기간이 끝나고 인탄은 드디어 정규직이 됐어요.

w|permata.en: That necklace is decorated with shining gems.

w|permata.text: Permata langka itu disimpan di brankas.
w|permata.en: That rare gem is kept in the vault.

w|permen.text: Anak itu meminta permen di toko.
w|permen.en: That child asked for candy at the store.
w|permen.ko: 그 아이가 가게에서 사탕을 달라고 했어.

w|permen.en: That mint candy freshens the breath.
w|permen.ko: 그 민트 사탕이 숨을 상쾌하게 해.

w|permohonan.text: Rudi mengajukan permohonan untuk meneliti arsip museum.
w|permohonan.en: Rudi submitted a request to research the museum archives.
w|permohonan.ko: 루디는 박물관 기록 보관소를 조사하겠다는 신청서를 냈어요.

w|permohonan.text: Para pedagang mengirim permohonan agar atap pasar segera diperbaiki.
w|permohonan.en: The traders sent a request for the market roof to be repaired soon.
w|permohonan.ko: 상인들은 시장 지붕을 빨리 고쳐 달라는 요청서를 냈어요.

w|permukaan.en: The surface of that table is very slippery.

w|permukaan.text: Air menutupi permukaan jalan setelah hujan.
w|permukaan.en: Water covered the road surface after the rain.
w|permukaan.ko: 비 뒤에 물이 도로 표면을 덮었어.

w|permulaan.text: Pada permulaan semester, setiap murid mendapat jadwal pelajaran baru.
w|permulaan.en: At the beginning of the semester, every student gets a new class schedule.
w|permulaan.ko: 학기 초에 학생마다 새 시간표를 받아요.

w|permulaan.text: Tinggal di kota baru adalah permulaan hidup yang berbeda bagi Siti.
w|permulaan.en: Living in a new city is the beginning of a different life for Siti.
w|permulaan.ko: 새 도시에서 사는 건 시티에게 다른 삶의 시작이에요.

w|pernah.en: Have you ever been to Bali?
I've never been on a plane.
w|pernah.ko: 비행기는 아직 한 번도 안 타 봤어.

w|pernikahan.en: I was invited to that wedding.

w|pernyataan.en: The minister issued an official statement.

w|pernyataan.ko: 그 성명이 많은 사람을 헷갈리게 했어.

w|perpisahan.text: Perpisahan di stasiun itu sangat mengharukan.
w|perpisahan.en: The farewell at the station was very moving.

w|perpisahan.text: Mereka mengadakan pesta perpisahan untuk guru.
w|perpisahan.en: They held a farewell party for the teacher.

w|perpustakaan.text: Saya belajar di perpustakaan setiap sore.
w|perpustakaan.en: I study in the library every afternoon.
The city library stays open until night.

w|pers.text: Majalah sekolah yang Eko kelola diundang ke acara pers di kantor bupati.
w|pers.en: The school magazine that Eko runs was invited to a press event at the regent's office.
w|pers.ko: 에코가 맡은 학교 잡지가 군청 기자 행사에 초대받았어요.

w|pers.text: Ayah Ayu dulu bekerja sebagai wartawan, jadi dia suka bercerita soal kebebasan pers.
w|pers.en: Ayu's father used to work as a journalist, so he likes talking about press freedom.
w|pers.ko: 아유의 아버지는 기자였어서 언론의 자유에 대해 이야기하는 걸 좋아해요.

w|persahabatan.en: Their friendship has lasted for years.
We keep our friendship even from afar.

w|persamaan.text: Kata Ayah, Budi dan Rina punya banyak persamaan, terutama sama-sama keras kepala.
w|persamaan.en: Dad says Budi and Rina have a lot in common, especially both being stubborn.
w|persamaan.ko: 아빠 말로는 부디와 리나는 닮은 점이 많은데, 특히 둘 다 고집이 세대요.

w|persamaan.text: Siti melihat banyak persamaan antara rumah ini dan rumah masa kecilnya.
w|persamaan.en: Siti sees many similarities between this house and her childhood home.
w|persamaan.ko: 시티는 이 집과 어릴 적 살던 집이 닮은 점이 많다고 느껴요.

w|persediaan.en: The drinking water supply is starting to run low.

w|persediaan.text: Toko menambah persediaan sebelum libur panjang.
w|persediaan.en: The store added inventory before the long holiday.

w|persembunyian.text: Dalam cerita itu, sang pahlawan menemukan tempat persembunyian para pencuri.
w|persembunyian.en: In that story, the hero finds the thieves' hideout.
w|persembunyian.ko: 그 이야기에서 주인공은 도둑들의 은신처를 찾아내요.

w|persembunyian.text: Ruang arsip di lantai bawah jadi tempat persembunyian favorit Intan saat butuh tenang.
w|persembunyian.en: The archive room downstairs is Intan's favourite hiding place when she needs quiet.
w|persembunyian.ko: 아래층 문서 보관실은 인탄이 조용히 있고 싶을 때 즐겨 숨는 곳이에요.

w|persen.text: Berapa persen dari kelas yang hadir hari ini?
w|persen.en: What percent of the class is present today?

w|persen.text: Diskon besar diberi dalam persen yang tinggi.
w|persen.en: A big discount is given at a high percent.

w|persetujuan.text: Proyek itu menunggu persetujuan dari atasan.
w|persetujuan.en: That project is waiting for approval from the boss.
w|persetujuan.ko: 그 프로젝트는 상사의 승인을 기다리고 있어.

w|persetujuan.en: Written approval is required before starting.

w|persiapan.text: Persiapan pesta memakan waktu satu minggu.

w|persiapan.en: They finished preparations for tomorrow's trip.

w|persidangan.text: Kelas Eko berkunjung ke pengadilan untuk menonton persidangan.
w|persidangan.en: Eko's class visited the courthouse to watch a trial.
w|persidangan.ko: 에코네 반은 재판을 방청하러 법원에 견학 갔어요.

w|persidangan.text: Kakak Ayu yang kuliah hukum sedang membaca berkas persidangan di kamar.
w|persidangan.en: Ayu's older brother, who studies law, is reading trial documents in his room.
w|persidangan.ko: 법대생인 아유의 오빠는 방에서 재판 서류를 읽고 있어요.

w|persimpangan.text: Agus salah belok di persimpangan dan akhirnya masuk ke pasar.
w|persimpangan.en: Agus took a wrong turn at the intersection and ended up in a market.
w|persimpangan.ko: 아구스는 교차로에서 잘못 꺾어서 결국 시장으로 들어갔어요.

w|persimpangan.text: Mal tempat Wati bekerja berada di persimpangan jalan protokol.
w|persimpangan.en: The mall where Wati works is at a main-road intersection.
w|persimpangan.ko: 와티가 일하는 쇼핑몰은 큰길 교차로에 있어요.

w|pertahanan.en: That team improved its back defense.

w|pertama.text: Ini kali pertama aku ke sini.
w|pertama.en: This is my first time here.

w|pertama-tama.en: First of all we have to read the instructions.
Let's first of all clean this table.

w|pertanda.text: Awan gelap adalah pertanda hujan akan datang.
w|pertanda.en: Dark clouds are a sign that rain is coming.

w|pertanda.text: Pertanda baik membuatnya lebih percaya diri.
w|pertanda.en: A good omen made him more confident.
w|pertanda.ko: 좋은 징조가 그를 더 자신 있게 했어.

w|pertanian.text: Pertanian menjadi tulang punggung desa itu.
w|pertanian.en: Agriculture is the backbone of that village.

w|pertanian.text: Dia belajar teknik pertanian modern di kampus.
w|pertanian.en: He studies modern farming techniques on campus.
w|pertanian.ko: 그는 캠퍼스에서 현대 농업 기술을 배워.

w|pertarungan.en: He won in the last fight.

w|pertempuran.en: They lost in the final battle.

w|pertengahan.text: Pada pertengahan musim hujan, sungai di dekat rumah Budi sering meluap.
w|pertengahan.en: In the middle of the rainy season, the river near Budi's house often overflows.
w|pertengahan.ko: 우기 중반이 되면 부디네 집 근처 강이 자주 넘쳐요.

w|pertengahan.text: Pada pertengahan syuting, kamera utama rusak dan harus diganti.
w|pertengahan.en: Midway through the shoot, the main camera broke and had to be replaced.
w|pertengahan.ko: 촬영 중반에 메인 카메라가 고장 나서 바꿔야 했어요.

w|pertolongan.text: Pertolongan pertama diberikan di tempat kejadian.
w|pertolongan.en: First aid was given at the scene.

w|pertolongan.text: Mereka meminta pertolongan kepada warga sekitar.
w|pertolongan.en: They asked nearby residents for help.

w|pertukaran.text: Pertukaran ide membuat proyek lebih kaya.
w|pertukaran.en: The exchange of ideas made the project richer.
w|pertukaran.ko: 아이디어 교환이 프로젝트를 더 풍성하게 했어.

w|pertunangan.text: Rina mengundang Andi ke acara pertunangan di rumahnya.
w|pertunangan.en: Rina invited Andi to the engagement ceremony at her house.
w|pertunangan.ko: 리나는 자기 집에서 열리는 약혼식에 안디를 초대했어요.

w|pertunangan.text: Restoran hotel penuh karena ada acara pertunangan sepasang dokter muda.
w|pertunangan.en: The hotel restaurant was full because of an engagement party for a young doctor couple.
w|pertunangan.ko: 젊은 의사 커플의 약혼식이 있어서 호텔 식당이 꽉 찼어요.

w|pertunjukan.en: We watched a magic show together.

w|perusahaan.en: She works at a new company.

w|perut.en: My stomach has hurt since morning.

w|perut.text: Dia memegang perut setelah makan terlalu banyak.
w|perut.en: He held his stomach after eating too much.
w|perut.ko: 너무 많이 먹은 뒤 배를 움켜쥐었어.

w|perwira.text: Perwira muda itu memimpin pasukan dengan tenang.
w|perwira.en: That young officer led the troops calmly.
w|perwira.ko: 그 젊은 장교가 부대를 침착하게 이끌었어.

w|perwira.text: Dia ingin menjadi perwira setelah lulus akademi.
w|perwira.en: He wants to become an officer after graduating from the academy.
w|perwira.ko: 그는 사관학교를 졸업한 뒤 장교가 되고 싶어해.

w|pesanan.en: The food order arrived on time.

w|pesanan.text: Dia membatalkan pesanan karena salah ukuran.
w|pesanan.en: She canceled the order because of the wrong size.

w|pesta.en: I was invited to a party.

w|petani.text: Petani itu menuai padi di sawah.
w|petani.en: That farmer is harvesting rice in the field.

w|petani.text: Banyak petani menjual hasil di pasar.
w|petani.en: Many farmers sell their harvest at the market.

w|petarung.text: Andi kaget waktu tahu Rina dulu petarung silat tingkat provinsi.
w|petarung.en: Andi was surprised to learn Rina used to be a provincial-level silat fighter.
w|petarung.ko: 안디는 리나가 예전에 주 대표 실랏 선수였다는 걸 알고 놀랐어요.

w|petarung.text: Seorang petarung tinju terkenal menginap di hotel sebelum pertandingan.
w|petarung.en: A famous boxer stayed at the hotel before the match.
w|petarung.ko: 유명한 권투 선수가 경기 전에 호텔에 묵었어요.

w|peternakan.text: Peternakan sapi itu luas dan bersih.
w|peternakan.en: That cattle farm is large and clean.

w|peternakan.text: Dia bekerja di peternakan ayam sejak muda.
w|peternakan.en: He has worked on a chicken farm since youth.
w|peternakan.ko: 그는 젊을 때부터 닭 농장에서 일했어.

w|peti.text: Peti kayu itu penuh barang lama.
w|peti.en: That wooden chest is full of old things.
w|peti.ko: 그 나무 상자가 옛 물건으로 가득해.

w|peti.en: They opened a chest in the warehouse.

w|petir.text: Petir menyambar pohon di depan rumah.
w|petir.en: Lightning struck the tree in front of the house.

w|petir.text: Suara petir membuat anak itu menangis.
w|petir.en: The sound of thunder made the child cry.

w|petualangan.text: Petualangan di hutan itu sangat seru.
w|petualangan.en: That adventure in the forest was very exciting.

w|petunjuk.en: Read the instructions on the front page.

w|pewaris.text: Seorang pewaris tanah luas datang ke balai kota untuk mengurus sertifikat.
w|pewaris.en: An heir to a large plot of land came to city hall to handle the certificate.
w|pewaris.ko: 넓은 땅을 물려받은 상속자가 증서를 처리하러 시청에 왔어요.

w|pewaris.text: Wati adalah pewaris biola tua milik kakeknya.
w|pewaris.en: Wati is the heir to her grandfather's old violin.

w|piala.text: Museum olahraga memamerkan piala pertama yang dimenangkan tim nasional.
w|piala.en: The sports museum displays the first trophy won by the national team.
w|piala.ko: 스포츠 박물관에는 국가대표팀이 처음 딴 트로피가 전시돼 있어요.

w|piala.text: Pasar Rina pernah meraih piala sebagai pasar terbersih se-provinsi.
w|piala.en: Rina's market once won a trophy as the cleanest market in the province.
w|piala.ko: 리나네 시장은 도내에서 가장 깨끗한 시장으로 상을 받은 적이 있어요.

w|piano.text: Piano di ruang tamu butuh disetem.
w|piano.en: The piano in the living room needs tuning.

w|piano.text: Anaknya belajar bermain piano setiap sore.
w|piano.en: Her child learns to play piano every afternoon.
w|piano.ko: 그의 아이는 매일 오후 피아노를 배워.

w|pidato.text: Pidato Presiden disiarkan di seluruh negeri.
w|pidato.en: The President's speech was broadcast nationwide.

w|pidato.text: Dia menulis pidato untuk acara wisuda.
w|pidato.en: She wrote a speech for the graduation ceremony.

w|pil.en: The doctor gave a pill for his fever.

w|pil.text: Dia menelan pil dengan segelas air.
w|pil.en: She swallowed the pill with a glass of water.
w|pil.ko: 그녀는 물 한 잔과 함께 알약을 삼켰어.

w|pilot.en: The pilot announced the landing time.
He dreams of becoming an airplane pilot.
w|pilot.ko: 그는 비행기 기장이 되는 게 꿈이야.

w|pimpinan.en: Company leadership announced a new plan.

w|pimpinan.text: Dia dipercaya menjadi pimpinan tim proyek.
w|pimpinan.en: He was trusted to become the project team leader.
w|pimpinan.ko: 그는 프로젝트 팀 리더를 맡게 됐어.

w|pindah.text: Kami akan pindah ke kota lain.
w|pindah.en: We will move to another city.
Moving house needs a lot of preparation.

w|pinggang.text: Setelah mengangkat anjing besar, Dimas mengeluh pinggang terasa pegal.
w|pinggang.en: After lifting a big dog, Dimas complained that his lower back felt sore.
w|pinggang.ko: 큰 개를 들어 올린 뒤 디마스는 허리가 뻐근하다고 했어요.

w|pinggang.text: Putri memakai sabuk penyangga pinggang saat mengangkat kotak berat.
w|pinggang.en: Putri wears a back-support belt when lifting heavy boxes.
w|pinggang.ko: 푸트리는 무거운 상자를 들 때 허리 보호대를 해요.

w|pinggir.text: Teater kecil itu berada di pinggir kota, dekat stasiun lama.
w|pinggir.en: That small theatre is on the edge of the city, near the old station.
w|pinggir.ko: 그 작은 극장은 옛 기차역 근처, 도시 변두리에 있어요.

w|pinggir.text: Intan duduk di pinggir meja rapat supaya bisa keluar lebih dulu.
w|pinggir.en: Intan sat at the end of the meeting table so she could leave first.
w|pinggir.ko: 인탄은 먼저 나갈 수 있게 회의 테이블 끝자리에 앉았어요.

w|pingsan.text: Pingsan di tengah jalan sangat berbahaya.
w|pingsan.en: Fainting in the middle of the road is very dangerous.
w|pingsan.ko: 길 한가운데서 기절하는 건 아주 위험해.

w|pinjam.en: May I borrow your pencil for a moment?

w|pinjam.text: Pinjam buku itu hanya untuk semalam.
w|pinjam.en: Borrow that book only for one night.

w|pinjaman.text: Pinjaman bank membantu membuka usaha kecil.
w|pinjaman.en: A bank loan helped open a small business.
w|pinjaman.ko: 은행 대출이 작은 가게를 여는 데 도움이 됐어.

w|pinjaman.text: Dia melunasi pinjaman lebih cepat dari jadwal.
w|pinjaman.en: He paid off the loan faster than scheduled.

w|pintu.en: The front door is still open.

w|pipa.en: The water pipe in the kitchen is leaking.

w|pipa.text: Teknisi memperbaiki pipa di ruang bawah.
